English:
Three months ago my sister Astrid and I were put in charge of the Ranger Station on Balboa. We handled the bear population and kept the relay towers operational. The next shift was meant to start weeks back. But the replacements never showed up.

HENRY suggested that I start writing things down after Astrid disappeared so that I'm not feeling so lonely anymore.
~BRUNO
Čeština [cs]: Pred tremi mesici jsme se sestrou Astrid dostaly na starost stanici rangeru na Balboe. Staraly jsme se o medvedy a udrzovaly v provozu retranslacni veze. Dalsi smena mela nastoupit uz pred nekolika tydny. Jenze nahradnici se nikdy neukazali.HENRY mi navrhl, abych si po Astridine zmizeni zacal zapisovat sve myslenky, abych se necitil tak osamele.~BRUNO

English:
The kids are fighting. Astrid would have known how to make them stop. I found her wrench out by the clearing. I’ve been calling out on the radio. Please. I just want to talk, sis.

MIRANDA is screaming outside. I hope her and HENRY make up soon.
~BRUNO
Čeština [cs]: Deti se hadaji. Astrid by vedela, jak je uklidnit. Nasel jsem jeji klic u mytiny. Volam do vysilacky. Prosim. Chci si jen promluvit, sestricko.MIRANDA venku krici. Doufam, ze se s HENRYM brzy usmiri.~BRUNO

English:
I haven’t seen ERROL all night. I asked MIRANDA but she and HENRY won’t tell me anything. They’re hiding something. Did they figure out there’s only space for two of them on the boat? I’ve decided. I’ll leave the TRIPLETS in charge of the remaining relay stations. BOBBY will take care of the bears. Yes. It’s for the best.

So many memories of this place. We’ll find you, sis. I promise.
~BRUNO
Čeština [cs]: ERROLA jsem celou noc nevidel. Pt al jsem se MIRANDY, ale ona ani HENRY mi nic nereknou. Neco taji. Zjistili snad, ze se na lodi najde misto jen pro dva? Rozhodl jsem se. English:
DETTO'S SCIENTIFIC JOURNAL -CLASSIFIED-

Ma says I should write down what I think to make it stick, so I write. Caravan Town is a rock, sticking out from the water. It has good land, to raise pigs to eat. We can fish. Grow vegetables. Only downside are the hyenas, but they are usually friendly.

We came here on a boat, with half the rest of Jakarta. They let us stay because Ma is smart and Pa is good at welding. They say I'm just another mouth to feed, but I'll show them! See the problem is, the water is rising, right?

What if we just take away the water?
Čeština [cs]: DETTOUV VEDECKY DENIK – TAJNEMama rika, ze si mam zapisovat, co si myslim, aby mi to zustalo v hlave, tak pisu. Caravan Town je skala vycnivajici z vody. Ma dobrou pudu, na ktere se daji chovat prasata na maso. Muzeme take rybarit. Lide me tu nechali zustat, protoze mama je chytra a tata umi dobre svarovat. Rikaji, ze jsem jen dalsi hladovy krk, ale ja jim ukazu!

English:
DETTO'S SCIENTIFIC JOURNAL -TOP TOP SECRET-

Sanjay says the water pump idea doesn't work, because there isn't enough space in the well for all the water. Also, the neighbors complain about getting salt in their cups. They complain because they have no patience for science!

I asked Pa why we can’t fly to another planet without all this water. Pa just laughed. But Sanjay showed me some pictures that gave me a great idea though… 

Good man, Sanjay.
Čeština [cs]: DETTOUV VEDECKY DENIK – PRISNE TAJNESanjay rika, ze napad s vodni pumpou nefunguje, protoze ve studni neni dost mista na vsechnu vodu. Sousede si navic stezuji, ze maji v hrncich slanou vodu. Musim vymyslet neco jineho.

English:
DETTO'S EXPERIMENT JOURNAL -ATTEMPT #733-

Pa helped me weld the rocket together, and Sanjay borrowed some fireworks to get it started.

Pa had to apologize to everyone for the explosion. I don’t get it, it was just a test. What an overreaction! They would have taken my tools if Sanjay hadn’t helped me put out the fire.

Good helper, Sanjay.
Čeština [cs]: DETTOUV EXPERIMENTALNI DENIK – POKUS C. 733Tata mi pomohl svarit raketu a Sanjay si pujcil nejake ohnostroje, abychom ji odpalili.Tata se musel vsem omluvit za vybuch. Nechapu to, vzdyt to byla jen mala exploze!

English:
DETTO'S SCIENTIFIC JOURNAL -UNDERWATER CACHES-

Sanjay ran off crying as soon as they dragged me out. Very unprofessional.

There’s lots of debri underwater. I couldn’t get anything out though. Sad. Pa forbade me from doing any more experiments. I think he’s just angry because Ma got sick.

Doctor Henry said she will be okay, so it’s okay.
Čeština [cs]: DETTOUV VEDECKY DENIK – PODVODNI ZASOBYSanjay se rozbehl pryc a rozplakal se, hned jak me vytahli ven. Velmi neprofesionalni.Pod vodou je spousta trosek. Nic se mi ale nepodarilo vytahnout. Skoda. Tata mi zakazal znovu se potapet bez dozoru.

English:
DETTO'S SCIENTIFIC JOURNAL -MONSTER INVESTIGATION-

There’s a stranger in town called Olof something. Pa keeps going to his meetings, no kids allowed. But at night I got Sanjay to help me sneak onto the stranger’s ship. I thought maybe he had some medicine for Ma…

But Olof’s boat was just filled with cages. In the cages were big rats, and a… very large hyena. They were so angry! Sanjay found notes talking about feeding and training them into his personal ‘army’. Sanjay thinks Olof might be a bad guy.

I think I agree.
Čeština [cs]:
DETTOUV VEDECKY DENIK – VYZKUM PRISER –

Ve meste je nejaky cizinec jmenem Olof nebo tak nejak. Tata chodi na jeho schuze, kam deti nesmeji. V noci mi ale Sanjay pomohl proplizit se na cizincovu lod. Napadlo me, ze by mohl mit nejake leky pro mamu…

Jenze Olofova lod byla plna kleci. V nich byly velke krysy a… obrovska hyena. Byly strasne rozzurene! Sanjay nasel poznamky o tom, jak je krmit a cvicit, aby z nich Olof vytvoril svou osobni „armadu“. Sanjay si mysli, ze Olof je padouch.

Myslim, ze s nim souhlasim.

English:
DETTO'S ADVENTURE JOURNAL

Pa says we have to go. Ma is getting sicker, and I heard that strange man Olof shouting orders. I saw them rounding up all the hyenas in cages. Sanjay is helping separate the rafts from the rocks.

I asked Doctor Henrik about Ma. He looked sick too. Told me to avoid the pigs. And Olof.

Sanjay says he’s scared. Smart man, Sanjay.
Čeština [cs]:
DETTOUV DENIK DOBRODRUZSTVI

Tata rika, ze musime odjet. Mama je cim dal nemocnejsi a slysel jsem toho podivneho muze Olofa, jak vykrikuje rozkazy. Videl jsem je, jak zaviraji vsechny hyeny do kleci. Sanjay pomaha oddelovat vory od skal.

Ptal jsem se doktora Henrika na mamu. Vypadal take nemocne. Rekl mi, at se vyhybam prasatum. A Olofovi.

Sanjay rika, ze ma strach. Chytry clovek, ten Sanjay.

English:
It’s been three days. Stuck in this shack, sick as a dog. I don’t think I can treat anyone in my condition and these people know it. I asked them to leave me here.

It’s the pigs. For weeks they’ve acted erratic. I’ve been blind to it. I didn’t even notice the butchers getting sick. It all started when Olof Wilkstrom arrived and I do not see it as a coincidence.
~Dr. Henrik Scholl
Čeština [cs]:
Uz jsou to tri dny. Jsem uvezneny v tehle chatrci a je mi priserne. V tomhle stavu asi nikoho lecit nedokazu a tihle lide to vedi. Pozadal jsem je, aby me tu nechali.

Jsou to ta prasata. Uz tydny se chovaji podivne. Byl jsem slepy. Ani jsem si nevsiml, ze reznici zacali byt nemocni. Vsechno zacalo, kdyz dorazil Olof Wilkstrom, a nemyslim si, ze je to nahoda.
~Dr. Henrik Scholl

English:
SPEECH TO THE RAFTERS, 17th of may FITFH DRAFT

why do you - Why do you think I, Olof Wilkstrom, left that corrupt city? Because they refused to let regular working class folk on board. I was appalled. Why should the elite get to escape the apocalypse? They should be FORCED to share their luxury.

-Pause for applause-

Who should force them? That’s right. The greatest rafters in this new southern sea. YOU! TAKE TANGAROA! TAKE BACK YOUR FUTURE!
Čeština [cs]:
PROJEV K LIDEM NA VORECH, 17. KVETNA – PATA VERZE

Proc… Proc si myslite, ze jsem ja, Olof Wilkstrom, opustil to zkorumpovane mesto? Protoze odmitli pustit na palubu obycejne pracujici lidi. Byl jsem zdeseny. Proc by mela elita uniknout apokalypse? MELI BY BYT DONUCENI, aby se podelili o svuj luxus.

– Pauza na potlesk –

Kdo je k tomu donuti? Presne tak. Nejlepsi lide na vorech v tomto novem jiznim mori. VY! DOBYJTE TANGAROU! VEZMETE SI ZPET SVOU BUDOUCNOST!

English:
The flooding of Jakarta has led to escaping locals creating interconnected rafts as they make their way to land.

“We just make do,” said Putri Reyes, one of the earlier adopters of these raft-towns, when inquired by one of our reporters about their living conditions. Drifting largely on sea-currents, they appear to be growing at a steady rate, raising considerable concerns with coastal authorities.
Čeština [cs]: Zaplavy v Jakarte primely mistni obyvatele k uteku. Na ceste k pevnine vytvareji propojene vory.\n\n„Nejak si poradime,“ rekla Putri Reyes, jedna z prvnich obyvatelek techto vorovych mestecek, kdyz se ji nas reporter ptal na zivotni podminky. Mestecka se nechavaji unaset predevsim morskymi proudy a zda se, ze stabilne rostou, coz vyvolava znacne obavy pobreznich uradu.

English: "A maritime hazard in the making," the foreign minister stated this morning in a public adress. Despite these concerns many believe raft towns could very well be a viable alternative. Čeština [cs]: V noci mi ale Sanjay pomohl proplizit se na cizincovu lod.

English: I thought maybe he had some medicine for Ma…
Čeština [cs]: Napadlo me, ze by mohl mit nejake leky pro mamu…

English: But Olof’s boat was just filled with cages. In the cages were big rats, and a… very large hyena.
Čeština [cs]: Jenze Olofova lod byla plna kleci. V nich byly velke krysy a… obrovska hyena.

English: They were so angry! Sanjay found notes talking about feeding and training them into his personal ‘army’.
Čeština [cs]: Byli strasne nastvani! Sanjay nasel poznamky o tom, jak je krmit a cvicit, aby z nich vytvoril svou osobni „armadu“.

English: Sanjay thinks Olof might be a bad guy. I think I agree.
Čeština [cs]: Sanjay si mysli, ze Olof je mozna padouch. Asi s nim souhlasim.

English: DETTO'S ADVENTURE JOURNAL
Čeština [cs]: DETTOUV DENIK DOBRODRUZSTVI

English: Pa says we have to go. Ma is getting sicker, and I heard that strange man Olof shouting orders.
Čeština [cs]: Tata rika, ze musime odjet. Mama je cim dal nemocnejsi a slysel jsem toho podivneho muze Olofa, jak vykrikuje rozkazy.

English: I saw them rounding up all the hyenas in cages. Sanjay is helping separate the rafts from the rocks.
Čeština [cs]: Videl jsem je, jak zaviraji vsechny hyeny do kleci. Sanjay pomaha oddelovat vory od skal.

English: I asked Doctor Henrik about Ma. He looked sick too. Told me to avoid the pigs. And Olof.
Čeština [cs]: Ptal jsem se doktora Henrika na mamu. Vypadal take nemocne. Rekl mi, at se vyhybam prasatum. A Olofovi.

English: Sanjay says he’s scared. Smart man, Sanjay.
Čeština [cs]: Sanjay rika, ze ma strach. Chytry clovek, ten Sanjay.

English: It’s been three days.
Čeština [cs]: Uz jsou to tri dny.

English: Stuck in this shack, sick as a dog. I don’t think I can treat anyone in my condition and these people know it.
Čeština [cs]: Jsem uvezneny v tehle chatrci a je mi priserne. V tomhle stavu asi nikoho lecit nedokazu a tihle lide to vedi.

English: I asked them to leave me here.
Čeština [cs]: Pozadal jsem je, aby me tu nechali.

English: It’s the pigs. For weeks they’ve acted erratic.
Čeština [cs]: Jsou to ta prasata. Uz tydny se chovaji podivne.

English: I’ve been blind to it. I didn’t even notice the butchers getting sick.
Čeština [cs]: Byl jsem slepy. Ani jsem si nevsiml, ze reznici zacinaji byt nemocni.

English: It all started when Olof Wilkstrom arrived and I do not see it as a coincidence.
Čeština [cs]: Vsechno zacalo, kdyz dorazil Olof Wilkstrom. Nemyslim si, ze je to nahoda.

English: SPEECH TO THE RAFTERS, 17th of may FITFH DRAFT
Čeština [cs]: PROJEV K LIDEM NA VORECH, 17. KVETNA – PATA VERZE

English: Why do you - Why do you think I, Olof Wilkstrom, left that corrupt city?
Čeština [cs]: Proc… Proc si myslite, ze jsem ja, Olof Wilkstrom, opustil to zkorumpovane mesto?

English: Because they refused to let regular working class folk on board. I was appalled.
Čeština [cs]: Protoze odmitli pustit na palubu obycejne pracujici lidi. Byl jsem zdeseny.

English: Why should the elite get to escape the apocalypse? They should be FORCED to share their luxury.
Čeština [cs]: Proc by mela elita uniknout apokalypse? MELI BY BYT DONUCENI, aby se podelili o svuj luxus.

English: Who should force them? That’s right. The greatest rafters in this new southern sea.
Čeština [cs]: Kdo je k tomu donuti? Presne tak. Nejlepsi lide na vorech v tomto novem jiznim mori.

English: YOU! TAKE TANGAROA! TAKE BACK YOUR FUTURE!
Čeština [cs]: VY! DOBYJTE TANGAROU! VEZMETE SI ZPET SVOU BUDOUCNOST!

English: The flooding of Jakarta has led to escaping locals creating interconnected rafts as they make their way to land.
Čeština [cs]: Zaplavy v Jakarte primely mistni obyvatele k uteku. Na ceste k pevnine vytvareji propojene vory.

English: “We just make do,” said Putri Reyes, one of the earlier adopters of these raft-towns, when inquired by one of our reporters about their living conditions.
Čeština [cs]: „Nejak si poradime,“ rekla Putri Reyes, jedna z prvnich obyvatelek techto vorovych mestecek, kdyz se ji nas reporter ptal na zivotni podminky.

English: Drifting largely on sea-currents, they appear to be growing at a steady rate, raising considerable concerns with coastal authorities.
Čeština [cs]: Mestecka se nechavaji unaset predevsim morskymi proudy a zda se, ze stabilne rostou, coz vyvolava znacne obavy pobreznich uradu.

English: "A maritime hazard in the making," the foreign minister stated this morning in a public address.
Čeština [cs]: „Tohle je rodici se namorni hrozba,“ prohlasil dnes rano ministr zahranici na verejnem projevu.

English: Despite these concerns many believe raft towns could very well be a viable alternative.
Čeština [cs]: Navzdory temto obavam mnozi veri, ze vorova mesta mohou byt zivotaschopnou alternativou.

English: My name is Sanjay. I think I’m in trouble.
Čeština [cs]: Jmenuji se Sanjay. Myslim, ze mam problem.

English: Detto put together a diving suit using a bike and an old diving helmet.
Čeština [cs]: Detto si z kola a stare potapecske helmy sestavil potapecsky oblek.

English: Detto put weights in it to go down, but he put in too much.
Čeština [cs]: Detto do nej pridal zavazi, aby klesal ke dnu, ale dal jich tam prilis mnoho.

English: Now if I leave then no one will pump air to Detto using the bike!
Čeština [cs]: Kdyz ted odejdu, nebude uz nikdo pumpovat Dettovi vzduch pomoci kola!

English: If I’m thrown in jail, this is proof I am innocent!
Čeština [cs]: Pokud me zavrou do vezeni, tohle dokazuje, ze jsem nevinny!

Čeština [cs]: Prvni stranka

Čeština [cs]: Ja a kluci.

Čeština [cs]: Pamatuj, za co bojujes.

Čeština [cs]: Uvidime se nekde v suchu. //Segra

English: If you want to catch the big one, just keep trying until you do! //Grandpa
Čeština [cs]: Jestli chces chytit poradny kus, zkousej to tak dlouho, dokud se ti to nepovede! //Deda

Čeština [cs]: Staci zavrit oci a budes zase tam.

English: To the biggest idiot in the world.
Čeština [cs]: Tomu nejvetsimu idiotovi na svete.

English:
Stop me if you’ve heard this one before: fifteen rafts go out, searching for land, six days before the mother of all storms.

It took us three months to prepare. The storm blew us apart and away in four days.
 
Now, there’s just me and the Raft, the sound of the waves and the rumbling in my gut. I’d brood, but I think I saw a shark.
 
Time to get to work.

Zastav me, jestli uz jsi tenhle pribeh slysel: patnact voru vyrazilo hledat pevninu sest dni pred nejvetsi bouri vsech dob.

Ted jsem tu jen ja a vor, zvuk vln a kruceni v zaludku. Asi bych mel premyslet, ale mam pocit, ze jsem zahledl zraloka.

English:
DECEMBER 12th:

We stopped for the night. Owl climbed the tower. Radio still works apparently. Should be two weeks before we reach Selene, but the team’s not responding.

You might say things are a bit tense. The other facilities are under water. So… If Selene is lost, we’ve got nothing. And now Sparrow’s not talking to either of us.

I really hope we’re not the last hope for humanity.
~Cuckoo
Čeština [cs]:
12. PROSINCE:

Zastavili jsme se na noc. Sova vylezla na vez. Radio zrejme stale funguje. Do Selene bychom meli dorazit za dva tydny, ale tym neodpovida.

Da se rict, ze atmosfera houstne. Ostatni zarizeni jsou pod vodou. Takze… pokud je Selene ztracena, nezbyva nam nic. A ted s nami Vrabec prestal mluvit.

Opravdu doufam, ze nejsme posledni nadeji lidstva.
~Kukacka

English:
JANUARY:

It’s been weeks. Just me and Owl here now, stuck on this platform. Sparrow took the boat. I can’t figure out why... Everything is just so secretive. I mean, I don’t even know their real names!

I only know the team at Selene got a prototype working and they needed more people. WE were supposed to be those people and Together we would find a way out of this mess. Somehow.

Owl’s yelling up in the tower. Maybe the radio picked up something? Is it you, Sparrow?
~Cuckoo
Čeština [cs]: LEDEN:Uz jsou to tydny. Zustali jsme tu jen ja a Sova, uvezneni na teto plosine. Vrabec odplul lodi. Nedokazu pochopit proc… Vsechno je tak tajnustkarske. Vzdyt ani neznam jejich skutecna jmena!Vim jen, ze tymu v Selene se podarilo zprovoznit prototyp a potrebovali dalsi lidi. MELI jsme jimi byt my a spolecne jsme meli najit cestu z tehle mizerie. Nejak.Sova nahore na vezi krici. Zachytilo radio neco? Jsi to ty, Vrabce?~Kukacka

English:
Errm… FEBRUARY(?) 

We’ve picked up a lot of signals. Maybe someone will come and help us. We’re not starving... yet.

The reactor at Selene might be the only chance we have against this endless ocean, and you knew it, Sparrow. Owl thinks you betrayed us. But you must have had a good reason for leaving us here.

I hope you make it to Selene. I hope you finish the reactor. For all of us.
~Cuckoo
Čeština [cs]:
Ehm… UNOR(?)

Zachytili jsme spoustu signalu. Mozna nam nekdo prijde pomoct. Zatim jeste neumirame hlady…

Reaktor v Selene muze byt nasi jedinou sanci proti tomuhle nekonecnemu oceanu, a ty jsi to vedel, Vrabce. Sova si mysli, ze jsi nas zradil. Ale musel jsi mit dobry duvod, proc jsi nas tu nechal.

Doufam, ze se do Selene dostanes. Doufam, ze reaktor dokoncis. Za nas za vsechny.
~Kukacka

English:
Captain Tulley ordered us to push the engines to their limits. We’re trying to outrun a fleet of rafts, or something. It’s going to overheat the reactor. I sent a message up the tower. Tulley doesn’t care.

I hope you’re faring better, Hanne. Much better.
~Ruben
Čeština [cs]: Kapitan Tulley nam naridil hnat motory az na hranici moznosti. Snazime se uniknout flotile voru, nebo necemu takovemu. Reaktor se kvuli tomu prehreje. Poslal jsem zpravu nahoru do veze. Tulleyho to nezajima.Doufam, ze se ti dari lepe, Hanne. O hodne lepe.Ruben

English:
The engines are done. People upstairs are already upset over the extreme rationing. Now we’re at the mercy of the waves.

And those rafts on the horizon are coming closer by the hour. I’m sealing up the reactor now. I don’t care what Captain Tulley says.

I really could’ve used you here, Hanne.
~Ruben
Čeština [cs]: Motory jsou mimo provoz. Lide nahore uz jsou nastvani kvuli drastickemu pridelovemu systemu. Ted jsme vydani napospas vlnam.A ty vory na obzoru se kazdou hodinou priblizuji. Prave uzaviram reaktor. Nezajima me, co rika kapitan Tulley.Opravdu bych te tu potreboval, Hanne.Ruben

English:
There’s screaming upstairs. After the Captain opened fire on the rafters, a damn riot broke out. Some supported Tulley’s orders. Others really did not.

A smaller raft made its way into the water entrance. But there was only a kid onboard. His parents were sick, I think. Poor boy isn’t saying much. 

Tangaroa’s a lost cause. We’re getting out of here.
~Ruben
Čeština [cs]: Nahore se krici. Pote co kapitan zahajil palbu na lidi na vorech, vypukly zatracene nepokoje. Nekteri Tulleyho rozkazy podporovali, jini rozhodne ne.Do vodniho vstupu vplul mensi vor. Na palube ale bylo jen dite. Myslim, ze jeho rodice byli nemocni. Chudak kluk toho moc nenamluvi.Tangaroa je ztracena. Odsud odjedeme.Ruben

English:
Things have gone quiet. Security teams still go on patrols in their ridiculous golf carts trying to keep some semblance of order. I heard the rafters let loose some type of rat. Oh, and they strapped tasers on all the butler bots! It’s like some kind of dumb guerilla war upstairs.

We’re fixing up a boat, but there’s no engine. The raft-kid thinks we could take one of the golf cart engines. It’s not a bad idea.

Captain Tulley and the ‘investors’ are still up in the tower. I say leave them there to rot.
~Ruben
Čeština [cs]: Vsechno se uklidnilo. Bezpecnostni tymy stale hlidkuji ve svych smesnych golfovych vozicich a snazi se udrzet alespon zdani poradku. Slysel jsem, ze lide z voru vypustili nejakeho potkana. A take nasadili paralyzery vsem robotum-komornikum! Nahore to pripomina nejakou pitomou partyzanskou valku.Opravujeme lod, ale nemame motor. Kluk z voru si mysli, ze bychom mohli pouzit motor z golfoveho voziku. To neni spatny napad.Kapitan Tulley a „investori“ jsou stale ve vezi. Podle me bychom je tam meli nechat shnit.Ruben

English:
The kid’s name is Detto. How someone his age was able to reconstruct an engine like that I’ll never know, but now we’ve got the boat working.

We’ll be gathering up a few more survivors before we head off. The rafters either hid up in the apartments or left to sea. Most of them seemed sick. No wonder they were so desperate. 

We need to hurry. Those large rats that came with the rafters are aggressive. I say let them chew Tangaroa into pieces. I’m coming for you, Hanne. Remember the place we heard about? The sanctuary? We’ll meet there. I know it.

I’ll see you there. Utopia.
~Ruben
Čeština [cs]: Ten kluk se jmenuje Detto. Nikdy nepochopim, jak nekdo v jeho veku dokazal znovu sestavit takovy motor, ale lod uz funguje.Nez vyrazime, posbirame jeste nekolik dalsich prezivsich. Velke krysy, ktere pripluly s lidmi z voru, jsou agresivni. At si Tangaroa rozkousou na kusy. Jdu si pro tebe, Hanne. Pamatujes na to misto, o kterem jsme slyseli? Na utociste? Sejdeme se tam. Tim jsem si jisty.Uvidime se tam. V Utopii.Ruben

English:
My name is James Tulley. This is my final message. Tangaroa City was built on a purely theoretical basis, using engines that had barely been tested, held together by the sweat and tears of our crew. But we were never sustainable. I should have accepted that months ago.

When the rafters arrived I could have let them starve with us. But I didn't. The only right choice was to abandon Tangaroa to the waves.

Now I will stay here, trapped in the cockpit with two dozen idiots who used to run the world. Don’t worry. We’ll pay for our sins before the end.
~Captain Tulley
Čeština [cs]: Jmenuji se James Tulley. Toto je moje posledni zprava. Mesto Tangaroa bylo postaveno na ciste teoretickych zakladech, s pouzitim motoru, ktere byly sotva otestovane, a drzelo pohromade jen diky potu a slzam nasi posadky. Nikdy jsme ale nebyli sobestacni. Mel jsem to prijmout uz pred mesici.Kdyz dorazili lide z voru, mohl jsem je nechat hladovet spolu s nami. Ale neudelal jsem to. Jedinou spravnou volbou bylo ponechat Tangaroa napospas vlnam.Ted zustanu tady, uvezneny v kokpitu se dvema tucty idiotu, kteri kdysi ridili svet. Nebojte se. Za sve hrichy zaplatime jeste pred koncem.Kapitan Tulley

English: Oh no, no, no. The entire ecosystem is ruined!
Čeština [cs]: Ach ne, ne, ne. Cely ekosystem je zniceny!

English: I’ve WARNED Captain Tulley about this for weeks now.
Čeština [cs]: Uz tydny VARUJI kapitana Tulleyho.

English: My contract doesn’t allow me to tell anyone else and it’s eating me up inside.
Čeština [cs]: Moje smlouva mi zakazuje rict to komukoli dalsimu a uzira me to zevnitr.

English: The banana plants won’t bear nearly enough fruit. Not to mention the infestations…
Čeština [cs]: Bananovniky neponesou ani zdaleka dost ovoce. A to nemluvim o skudcich…

English: We’ll be starving by the end of the year. If not sooner!
Čeština [cs]: Do konce roku budeme hladovet. Mozna i driv!

English: (Security) - “No sir, they haven’t done anything hostile. Yes, they’re still just chanting.”
Čeština [cs]: (Ostraha) – „Ne, pane, neudelali nic nepratelskeho. Ano, porad jen skanduji.“

English: (Captain Tulley) - *Muffled response.*
Čeština [cs]: (Kapitan Tulley) – *Nesrozumitelna odpoved.*

English: (Security) - ”Yes sir, I am armed. But if I may speak freely, we are able to use the water cannons if-”
Čeština [cs]: (Ostraha) – „Ano, pane, jsem ozbrojeny. Ale pokud mohu mluvit otevrene, muzeme pouzit vodni dela, pokud—“

English: (Captain Tulley) - *Muffled order.*
Čeština [cs]: (Kapitan Tulley) – *Nesrozumitelny rozkaz.*

English: (Security) - ”Yes, sir. No, sir.”
Čeština [cs]: (Ostraha) – „Ano, pane. Ne, pane.“

English: (Security) - ”Tulley says shoot to wound..?”
Čeština [cs]: (Ostraha) – „Tulley rika, ze mame strilet tak, abychom je zranili…?“

English: Captain Tulley ordered us to push the engines to their limits.
Čeština [cs]: Kapitan Tulley nam naridil hnat motory az na hranici moznosti.

English: We’re trying to outrun a fleet of rafts, or something. It’s going to overheat the reactor.
Čeština [cs]: Snazime se uniknout flotile voru, nebo necemu takovemu. Reaktor se kvuli tomu prehreje.

English: I sent a message up the tower. Tulley doesn’t care.
Čeština [cs]: Poslal jsem zpravu nahoru do veze. Tulleyho to nezajima.

English: I hope you’re faring better, Hanne. Much better.
Čeština [cs]: Doufam, ze se ti dari lepe, Hanne. O hodne lepe.

English: The engines are done. People upstairs are already upset over the extreme rationing.
Čeština [cs]: Motory jsou mimo provoz. Lide nahore uz jsou nastvani kvuli drastickemu pridelovemu systemu.

English: Now we’re at the mercy of the waves.
Čeština [cs]: Ted jsme vydani napospas vlnam.

English: And those rafts on the horizon are coming closer by the hour. I’m sealing up the reactor now.
Čeština [cs]: A ty vory na obzoru se kazdou hodinou priblizuji. Prave uzaviram reaktor.

English: I don’t care what Captain Tulley says. I really could’ve used you here, Hanne.
Čeština [cs]: Nezajima me, co rika kapitan Tulley. Opravdu bych te tu potreboval, Hanne.

English: There’s screaming upstairs. After the Captain opened fire on the rafters, a damn riot broke out.
Čeština [cs]: Nahore se krici. Pote co kapitan zahajil palbu na lidi na vorech, vypukly zatracene nepokoje.

English: Some supported Tulley’s orders. Others really did not.
Čeština [cs]: Nekteri Tulleyho rozkazy podporovali, jini rozhodne ne.

English: A smaller raft made its way into the water entrance. But there was only a kid onboard.
Čeština [cs]: Do vodniho vstupu vplul mensi vor. Na palube ale bylo jen dite.

English: His parents were sick, I think. Poor boy isn’t saying much.
Čeština [cs]: Myslim, ze jeho rodice byli nemocni. Chudak kluk toho moc nenamluvi.

English: Tangaroa’s a lost cause. We’re getting out of here.
Čeština [cs]: Tangaroa je ztracena. Odsud odjedeme.

English: Things have gone quiet.
Čeština [cs]: Vsechno se uklidnilo.

English: Security teams still go on patrols in their ridiculous golf carts trying to keep some semblance of order.
Čeština [cs]: Bezpecnostni tymy stale hlidkuji ve svych smesnych golfovych vozicich a snazi se udrzet alespon zdani poradku.

English: I heard the rafters let loose some type of rat. Oh, and they strapped tasers on all the butler bots!
Čeština [cs]: Slysel jsem, ze lide z voru vypustili nejakeho potkana. A take nasadili paralyzery vsem robotum-komornikum!

English: It’s like some kind of dumb guerilla war upstairs.
Čeština [cs]: Nahore to pripomina nejakou pitomou partyzanskou valku.

English: We’re fixing up a boat, but there’s no engine.
Čeština [cs]: Opravujeme lod, ale nemame motor.

English: The raft-kid thinks we could take one of the golf cart engines. It’s not a bad idea.
Čeština [cs]: Kluk z voru si mysli, ze bychom mohli pouzit motor z golfoveho voziku. To neni spatny napad.

English: Captain Tulley and the ‘investors’ are still up in the tower. I say leave them there to rot.
Čeština [cs]: Kapitan Tulley a „investori“ jsou stale ve vezi. Podle me bychom je tam meli nechat shnit.

English: Captain Tulley and the ‘investors’ are still up in the tower. I say leave them there to rot.
Čeština [cs]: Kapitan Tulley a „investori“ jsou stale ve vezi. Podle me bychom je tam meli nechat shnit.

English: The kid’s name is Detto.
Čeština [cs]: Ten kluk se jmenuje Detto.

English: How someone his age was able to reconstruct an engine like that I’ll never know, but now we’ve got the boat working.
Čeština [cs]: Nikdy nepochopim, jak nekdo v jeho veku dokazal znovu sestavit takovy motor, ale lod uz funguje.

English: We’ll be gathering up a few more survivors before we head off.
Čeština [cs]: Nez vyrazime, posbirame jeste nekolik dalsich prezivsich.

English: The rafters either hid up in the apartments or left to sea. Most of them seemed sick.
Čeština [cs]: Lide z voru se bud schovali v bytech, nebo odpluli na more. Vetsina z nich vypadala nemocne.

English: No wonder they were so desperate. We need to hurry.
Čeština [cs]: Neni divu, ze byli tak zoufali. Musime si pospisit.

English: Those large rats that came with the rafters are aggressive.
Čeština [cs]: Velke krysy, ktere prisly s lidmi na vorech, jsou agresivni.

English: I say let them chew Tangaroa into pieces. I’m coming for you, Hanne.
Čeština [cs]: Rikam, at Tangaroa klidne rozkousou na kusy. Jdu si pro tebe, Hanne.

English: Remember the place we heard about? The sanctuary? We’ll meet there. I know it.
Čeština [cs]: Pamatujes na to misto, o kterem jsme slyseli? Na utociste? Sejdeme se tam. Ja vim, ze tam bude.

English: I’ll see you there. Utopia.
Čeština [cs]: Uvidime se tam. V Utopii.

English: My name is James Tulley. This is my final message.
Čeština [cs]: Jmenuji se James Tulley. Tohle je moje posledni zprava.

Čeština [cs]: Mesto Tangaroa bylo postaveno na ciste teoretickych zakladech. Pouzili jsme motory, ktere byly sotva otestovane, a cele to drzelo pohromade jen diky potu a slzam nasi posadky.

English: But we were never sustainable. I should have accepted that months ago.
Čeština [cs]: Nikdy jsme ale nebyli sobestacni. Mel jsem si to priznat uz pred nekolika mesici.

Čeština [cs]: Kdyz dorazili lide na vorech, mohl jsem je nechat hladovet spolu s nami. Ale neudelal jsem to.

English: The only right choice was to abandon Tangaroa to the waves.
Čeština [cs]: Jedinou spravnou volbou bylo opustit Tangaroa a nechat ho napospas vlnam.

English: Now I will stay here, trapped in the cockpit with two dozen idiots who used to run the world.
Čeština [cs]: Ted zustanu tady, uvezneny v kokpitu se dvema tucty idiotu, kteri kdysi ridili svet.

English: Don’t worry. We’ll pay for our sins before the end.
Čeština [cs]: Nebojte se. Nez bude konec, zaplatime za sve hrichy.

English:
I’ve already lost MIRANDA. I will not lose you too, HENRY.

The two of us have followed a signal far south. I know it's from my sister. There’s no doubt. 

HENRY is skeptical. He thinks the cold will be dangerous. I'm more scared of whatever’s out there in the snowstorm…
~Bruno
Čeština [cs]: Uz jsem prisel o MIRANDU. Neztratim i tebe, HENRY. My dva jsme nasledovali signal daleko na jih. Vim, ze je od me sestry. O tom neni pochyb. HENRY o tom pochybuje, ale ja ne. Musim ji najit.

English:
There’s bears all over this frozen island!

One of them completely wrecked the boat when we tried to get away. None of the usual tricks worked either. HENRY and I would have been eaten if that boy with the airhorn hadn’t showed up. His name is Detto. Says he came here with some survivors.

I asked HENRY if I should trust the boy. But I didn’t get an answer.
~Bruno
Čeština [cs]: Na tomhle zamrzlem ostrove jsou vsude medvedi! Jeden z nich uplne znicil lod, kdyz jsme se pokusili utect. Nepomohly ani nase obvykle triky. HENRY a ja bychom byli v pekne kasi, kdybychom se nedostali pryc.

English:
Detto showed me and HENRY some abandoned igloos. The boy got them open by fiddling with some cables? The big igloo is still shut though. I wonder what’s inside…

Detto introduced me to a man named Ruben. He was hurt. Looked like wounds from a bear attack, so I helped fix up the wounds. Astrid used to fix up my wounds the same way.

Where are you, sis?
~Bruno
Čeština [cs]: Detto mi a HENRYMU ukazal nekolik opustenych iglu. Ten kluk je otevrel nejakym pohravanim si s kabely. To velke iglu je ale porad zavrene. Zajimalo by me, co je uvnitr… Detto mi predstavil dalsi ze svych vynalezu.

English:
That kid Detto is really smart. Using material we salvaged, he was able to fix up my boat. Ruben is recovering too, but... he doesn’t seem to want to talk to me a lot. Both of them stare whenever I talk to HENRY…?

HENRY doesn’t like the way they look at us. I think I need to do something.
~Bruno
Čeština [cs]: Ten kluk Detto je opravdu chytry. Z materialu, ktery jsme zachranili, dokazal opravit mou lod. Ruben se take zotavuje, ale… moc se mnou nechce mluvit. Oba se zmenili.

English:
The boat is ready to go. Detto is ready with the airhorn, and Ruben can at least walk.

HENRY is staying behind. It’s bittersweet. He doesn’t speak with me anymore, but I think it’s safer for someone to stay behind. Detto says there’s a place with lots of people. Ruben says Astrid might be there. She definitely isn’t here, in this cold place.

It’s nice talking to people.
~Bruno
Čeština [cs]: Lod je pripravena k odjezdu. Detto ma pripravenou vzduchovou houkacku a Ruben uz aspon dokaze chodit. HENRY zustava. Je to horkosladke. Uz se mnou nemluvi, ale myslim, ze chape, proc musim odejit.

English:
I am called Sparrow. Whoever finds this, know that I held humanity’s interest first. Always.

I was sent to Selene alongside two colleagues. One of which I discovered was a mole by the ‘investors’. Had Owl been allowed to come to Selene, the knowledge of this unlimited green energy would have been monopolized by the same people who caused this mess to begin with.

The other colleague… I left behind. I did not trust you, Cuckoo. I couldn’t. It was too much of a risk. I hope you will forgive me.
~Sparrow
Čeština [cs]: Rikaji mi Sparrow. Kdokoli tohle najde, at vi, ze jsem vzdy kladl na prvni misto zajmy lidstva. Byl jsem poslan do Selene se dvema kolegy. U jednoho z nich jsem zjistil, ze je speh.

English:
The Selene facility was built for one purpose: master and perfect the experimental reactors used to power the floating cities. No easy task. But it has been done. In theory. Yet we do not have the people to construct anything but a basic prototype. It can be built for real, I know it! We just need more people.

There’s a place where the rafters live in peace with any survivors of the old world. They call it Utopia. Maybe there we can begin to reverse the damage we’ve done. But we received a message from them yesterday. One of the ‘investors’ has taken control of the community. Olof Wilkstrom. I fear his intentions with this potential Utopia.
~Sparrow
Čeština [cs]: Zarizeni Selene bylo vybudovano za jedinym ucelem: ovladnout a zdokonalit experimentalni reaktory, ktere napajeji plovouci mesta. Nebyl to snadny ukol, ale podarilo se to. Teoreticky. Presto jsme jeste nemeli vyhrano.

Čeština [cs]: Detto rika, ze existuje misto, kde zije spousta lidi. Ruben tvrdi, ze by tam mohla byt Astrid.

Čeština [cs]: Urcite neni tady, na tomhle chladnem miste. Je prijemne zase si s nekym povidat.

Čeština [cs]: Mozna tam muzeme zacit napravovat skody, ktere jsme zpusobili. Vcera jsme od nich ale dostali zpravu.

Čeština [cs]: Jeden z investoru prevzal kontrolu nad komunitou. Olof Wilkstrom.

Čeština [cs]: Obavam se, jake ma s timto moznym utocistem umysly.

English:
FROM THE PEOPLE OF UTOPIA

Do NOT trust Olof Wilkstrom. When he arrived here we took his word in good faith. He exploited us at every turn. Now all of us ‘dissenters’ are locked up. Which is everyone, by my count.

To anyone reading this, Olof should be up in the marketplace. BEWARE of his rabid beasts! Please, take the master key from him. Set us free! Set Utopia FREE!
~Hanne, Utopia Representative
Čeština [cs]: OD LIDI Z UTOPIENEDUVERUJTE Olofovi Wilkstromovi. Kdyz sem dorazil, duverovali jsme mu. Pri kazde prilezitosti nas zneuzil. Ted jsme vsichni, kdo s nim nesouhlasi, zavreni.Podle meho odhadu uplne vsichni. Kdokoli to cte, Olof by mel byt na trzisti.POZOR na jeho vztekla zvirata! Prosim, vezmete mu hlavni klic.Pustte nas ven! Osvobodte Utopii!

English:
DETTO'S UTOPIA JOURNAL -SUPER SECRET-

I have my own raft! And it’s hooked up to actual wind turbines! If I had even more power, just imagine all the experiments I could run… 

But now that lunatic Olof appeared.  His cages are already unloaded and now he’s promising to help everyone with his ‘army’. 

Last I saw him, Olof Wilkstrom ruined Caravan Town. I will NEVER forgive him! I hope Hanne and Ruben listen to me. He is not to be trusted!

Just in case I’ve decided to up the security on my raft. This map should allow only the SMARTEST of people to enter!

Like me!
Čeština [cs]: DETTUV DENIK Z UTOPIE – PRISNE TAJNEMam vlastni vor! A je pripojeny ke skutecnym vetrnym turbinam! Kdybych mel jeste vic energie, predstavte si vsechny experimenty, ktere bych mohl provadet…Jenze ted se objevil ten silenec Olof. Uz vylozil sve klece a slibuje, ze vsem pomuze se svou „armadou“.Naposledy, kdyz jsem ho videl, Olof Wilkstrom znicil Caravan Town. NIKDY mu to neodpustim! Doufam, ze me Hanne a Ruben poslechnou. Neda se mu verit!Pro jistotu jsem se rozhodl zvysit zabezpeceni sveho voru. Tato mapa by mela pustit dovnitr jen ty NEJCHYTREJSI! Treba me!

English:
When the ocean itself broke the Forward Scouts, the survivors were left with nothing.

Yet they persisted, rose up from nothing, defied our flooded world, and brought back hope.

Now Utopia stands free once again thanks to their actions.

With this final chance we can begin the slow and difficult road to recovery.

From today on, we are all Forward Scouts, ready to discover the next step for humanity.
Čeština [cs]: Kdyz ocean sam znicil civilizaci, prezivsi zustali bez niceho.Presto vytrvali. Pruzkumnici povstali z trosek, postavili se nasemu zatopenemu svetu a vzdorovali mu.Diky jejich cinum je Utopie znovu svobodna.Diky teto posledni sanci muzeme zacit pomalou a obtiznou cestu k obnove.Od dnesniho dne jsme vsichni pruzkumnici, pripraveni objevit dalsi krok pro lidstvo.

English: That was so scary!
Čeština [cs]: To bylo tak desive!

English: I'm still a bit in shock.
Čeština [cs]: Porad jsem trochu v soku.

English: Good job dealing with that Olof fellow.
Čeština [cs]: Dobra prace s tim Olofem.

English: Let’s make sure it doesn’t happen again, okay?
Čeština [cs]: Postarejme se, aby se to uz neopakovalo, ano?

English: This Olof fellow doesn’t seem like the nicest type.
Čeština [cs]: Ten Olof nevypada jako zrovna mily clovek.

English: I heard Hanne is organizing new ‘scouts’ for something. Maybe I’ll go? I could look for Astrid.
Čeština [cs]: Slysel jsem, ze Hanne organizuje nove „pruzkumniky“. Mozna se pridam. Mohl bych hledat Astrid.

English: I don’t like being alone. But sometimes all these people is a bit much.
Čeština [cs]: Nemam rad samotu. Ale nekdy je tu tech lidi az moc.

English: At night I like looking out at the ocean. Suddenly I don’t feel so lonely anymore.
Čeština [cs]: V noci se rad divam na ocean. Najednou se uz necitim tak osamele.

English: Hanne says if you like yourself you’ll never be lonely. I wonder if I can learn to do that.
Čeština [cs]: Hanne rika, ze kdyz ma clovek rad sam sebe, nikdy neni osamely. Zajimalo by me, jestli se to muzu naucit.

English: Maybe I’ll go back to Balboa one day. Why? I… think I left someone behind.
Čeština [cs]: Mozna se jednoho dne vratim na Balbou. Proc? Ja… myslim, ze jsem tam nekoho nechal.

English: Several someones, in fact.
Čeština [cs]: Vlastne hned nekolik lidi.

English: It was a long journey to get here. But look at this place! So many people!
Čeština [cs]: Cesta sem byla dlouha. Ale podivej se na tohle misto! Tolik lidi!

English: Life here is not so bad. I will show Astrid one day.
Čeština [cs]: Zivot tady neni tak spatny. Jednou to tu ukazu Astrid.

English: That kid Detto has so many new ideas. I can’t wrap my head around them! I’ll stick to my radios.
Čeština [cs]: Ten kluk Detto ma tolik novych napadu. Nedokazu je vsechny pochopit! Ja zustanu u svych vysilacek.

English: Astrid was the bear expert. I was the radio guy. That’s how we split the workload.
Čeština [cs]: Astrid se vyznala v medvedech a ja byl pres vysilacky. Tak jsme si rozdelili praci.

English: Hanne and Ruben said I did some great things to their radio setup.
Čeština [cs]: Hanne a Ruben rikali, ze jsem jejich radiove vybaveni skvele opravil.

English: I wouldn’t call it great, but it’s nice to be able to help.
Čeština [cs]: Nenazval bych to skvelym, ale je fajn, ze muzu pomoct.

English: Thank you for letting us out! It was getting cramped in there.
Čeština [cs]: Diky, ze jsi nas pustil ven! Uz tam zacinalo byt tesno.

English: Honestly, I don’t miss the bears. Pretty happy that there aren’t any here.
Čeština [cs]: Uprimne, medvedi mi nechybi. Jsem rad, ze tu zadni nejsou.

English: Wouldn’t that be weird though? Bears in a skyscraper? Haha. You haven’t seen any have you?
Čeština [cs]: Ale nebylo by to divne? Medvedi v mrakodrapu? Haha. Zadne jsi tu nevidel, ze ne?

English: Temperance was a strange island. Just abandoned.
Čeština [cs]: Temperance byl zvlastni ostrov. Uplne opusteny.

English: Hanne thinks we’ll go back there soon. Give everything another go.
Čeština [cs]: Hanne si mysli, ze se tam brzy vratime. Zkusime to znovu.

English: You haven’t met a woman called Astrid, have you? No? If you do, let me know.
Čeština [cs]: Nepotkal jsi zenu jmenem Astrid, ze ne? Ne? Kdybys ji potkal, dej mi vedet.

English: I miss Henry. He always knew what to say.
Čeština [cs]: Chybi mi Henry. Vzdycky vedel, co rict.

English: Miranda went her own way. I’m sure she’s alright out there, somewhere. Hopefully not alone.
Čeština [cs]: Miranda se vydala vlastni cestou. Urcite je nekde tam venku v poradku. Doufam, ze neni sama.

English: I’m just going to focus on finding Astrid now.
Čeština [cs]: Ted se soustredim jen na hledani Astrid.

English: My sister is out there somewhere, I know it!
Čeština [cs]: Moje sestra je nekde tam venku, ja to vim!

English: You were on Balboa? The bears weren’t too much of a hassle, I hope.
Čeština [cs]: Byl jsi na Balboe? Doufam, ze ti medvedi nezpusobili prilis velke potize.

English: You’ve been to Temperance too? You must really like bears.
Čeština [cs]: Byl jsi i na Temperance? Ty mas ty medvedy opravdu rad.

English: FROM THE PEOPLE OF UTOPIA
Čeština [cs]: OD LIDI Z UTOPIE

English: Do NOT trust Olof Wilkstrom. When he arrived here we took his word in good faith.
Čeština [cs]: NEDUVERUJTE Olofovi Wilkstromovi. Kdyz sem dorazil, duverovali jsme mu.

English: He exploited us at every turn. Now all of us ‘dissenters’ are locked up.
Čeština [cs]: Zneuzival nas na kazdem kroku. Ted jsme vsichni, kdo s nim nesouhlasi, zavreni.

English: Which is everyone, by my count. To anyone reading this, Olof should be up in the marketplace.
Čeština [cs]: Podle meho odhadu uplne vsichni. Kdokoli to cte, Olof by mel byt na trzisti.

English: BEWARE of his rabid beasts! Please, take the master key from him.
Čeština [cs]: POZOR na jeho vztekla zvirata! Prosim, vezmete mu hlavni klic.

English: Set us free! Set Utopia FREE!
Čeština [cs]: Pustte nas ven! Osvobodte Utopii!

English: The turbines are still working, wonderful.
Čeština [cs]: Turbiny stale funguji, to je skvele.

English: Ruben went to check up on the systems straight away.
Čeština [cs]: Ruben sel hned zkontrolovat systemy.

English: Without him we’d still be using candles every night.
Čeština [cs]: Bez nej bychom kazdou noc stale pouzivali svicky.

English: It would be nice if we had a proper reactor, like on Tangaroa.
Čeština [cs]: Bylo by skvele mit poradny reaktor, jako maji v Tangaroa.

English: Maybe one day.
Čeština [cs]: Treba jednou.

English: No one ever listens to me. Maybe they’ll listen after this!
Čeština [cs]: Nikdo me nikdy neposloucha. Treba me po tomhle konecne uslysi!

English: Hanne promised me I would get to experiment on the water system!
Čeština [cs]: Hanne mi slibila, ze budu moct experimentovat s vodnim systemem!

English: As long as I promise to not break anything. And remember how to put it back together.
Čeština [cs]: Pokud slibim, ze nic nerozbiju. A ze si budu pamatovat, jak to zase slozit.

English: And remember how to make it work again.
Čeština [cs]: A taky si pamatovat, jak to znovu zprovoznit.

English: Hanne says there is a lot of stuff on the bottom of the ocean.
Čeština [cs]: Hanne rika, ze na dne oceanu je spousta veci.

English: An entire world! I’ll try making another diving suit…
Čeština [cs]: Cely svet! Zkusim vyrobit dalsi potapecsky oblek…

English: I found some notes on Temperance too, you know.
Čeština [cs]: Mimochodem, nasel jsem take nejake poznamky na Temperance.

English: Once the grown ups have decided, I’m going to try building one of those reactors myself!
Čeština [cs]: Az se dospeli rozhodnou, zkusim si jeden z tech reaktoru postavit sam!

English: Don’t tell Ruben, it’s a secret!
Čeština [cs]: Nerikej to Rubenovi, je to tajemstvi!

English: What is that saying…? Better to ask forgiveness than permission? Yeah, that’s what I’ll do!
Čeština [cs]: Jak se to rika…? Je lepsi prosit za odpusteni nez zadat o svoleni? Jo, presne tak to udelam!

English: I have so many ideas! No, it’s top secret. Stop asking.
Čeština [cs]: Mam tolik napadu! Ne, je to prisne tajne. Prestan se ptat.

English: I have a feeling I’m going to save the world. What are you laughing for?
Čeština [cs]: Mam pocit, ze zachranim svet. Cemu se smejes?

English: Bruno is leaving with some scouts, I think. He needs to find his sister!
Čeština [cs]: Bruno podle me odchazi s nekolika pruzkumniky. Musi najit svou sestru!

English: It’s good Bruno isn’t talking to dolls anymore. He can talk to people instead!
Čeština [cs]: Je dobre, ze Bruno uz nemluvi s panenkami. Ted muze mluvit s lidmi!

English: Yeah, Bruno’s radios are fine. Great. But he’s thinking too small.
Čeština [cs]: Jo, Brunova radia funguji skvele. Ale mysli prilis v malem.

English: Imagine all the things we could send to each other if we were more connected.
Čeština [cs]: Predstav si, co vsechno bychom si mohli posilat, kdybychom byli lepe propojeni.

English: Like photos! Or even better, invention schematics!
Čeština [cs]: Treba fotografie! Nebo jeste lepe plany vynalezu!

English: I’m pretty popular around here. Soon the whole ocean will hear about Detto, master inventor!
Čeština [cs]: Jsem tu docela popularni. Brzy se o Dettovi, mistru vynalezci, dozvi cely ocean!

English: Good work! Olof won’t be ruining anything else, as long as I have a say in it!
Čeština [cs]: Dobra prace! Olof uz nic dalsiho neznici, dokud o tom budu rozhodovat!

English: Believe me, I’m going right back to working on the next experiment!
Čeština [cs]: Ver mi, hned se vratim k praci na dalsim experimentu!

English: Hanne and Ruben are the perfect people to keep Utopia running.
Čeština [cs]: Hanne a Ruben jsou idealni lide, kteri udrzi Utopii v chodu.

English: I would know, I have good people skills.
Čeština [cs]: Ja to musim vedet, s lidmi to umim.

English: Okay, okay. So how do we dry the world? Great question! Um. I’m working on it, okay?
Čeština [cs]: Dobre, dobre. Tak jak vysusime svet? Skvela otazka! Ehm… pracuju na tom, jo?

English: The weirdos at Selene had some ideas! I don’t get them entirely, but one day I will!
Čeština [cs]: Ti podivini ze Selene meli par napadu! Uplne jim nerozumim, ale jednou budu!

English: So annoying. I had to get new tools after I lost mine at that other skyscraper place.
Čeština [cs]: To je otrava. Musel jsem si poridit nove naradi, protoze jsem ho ztratil u toho druheho mrakodrapu.

English: I could probably improve your raft a lot! Ruben won’t let me though.
Čeština [cs]: Tvuj vor bych dokazal poradne vylepsit! Ruben mi to ale nedovoli.

English: You’re pretty crafty too! But have you built a rocketship? Didn’t think so!
Čeština [cs]: Ty jsi taky sikovny! Ale postavil jsi nekdy raketu? To jsem si myslel!

English: Ruben is always on the move. Couldn't even stay to celebrate freedom!
Čeština [cs]: Ruben je porad v pohybu. Nezustal ani na oslavu svobody!

English: So glad Ruben and Hanne finally found each other!
Čeština [cs]: Jsem tak rad, ze se Ruben a Hanne konecne nasli!

English: I think Ruben is off looking for parts or something? The powergrid was pretty wrecked after all!
Čeština [cs]: Myslim, ze Ruben sel hledat soucastky nebo neco takoveho. Elektricka sit byla poradne znicena!

English: Want to hear a controversial opinion? Olof really sucks!
Čeština [cs]: Chces slyset kontroverzni nazor? Olof je fakt hrozny!

English: Mom always said to stay away from the hyenas around Caravan Town.
Čeština [cs]: Mama mi vzdycky rikala, abych se drzel dal od hyen u Caravan Town.

English: But they never hurt anyone! Not until Olof turned them all angry.
Čeština [cs]: Ale nikdy nikomu neublizily! Tedy az do chvile, kdy je Olof vsechny rozzuril.

English: We should get some more animals here at Utopia. Personally, I want a llama and a pet shark.
Čeština [cs]: V Utopii bychom meli mit vic zvirat. Ja osobne chci lamu a ochoceneho zraloka.

English: Doctor Henry really cared about everyone in Caravan Town! I hope he made it out okay.
Čeština [cs]: Doktor Henry se o vsechny v Caravan Town opravdu staral! Doufam, ze se dostal do bezpeci.

English: Maybe I'll become a doctor when I grow up. Or an engineer. Or a doctoneer!
Čeština [cs]: Mozna se stanu doktorem, az vyrostu. Nebo inzenyrem. Nebo doktyzenyrem!

English: How long do you think it takes to build a floating city? Couple of weeks, maybe?
Čeština [cs]: Jak dlouho myslis, ze trva postavit plovouci mesto? Par tydnu, mozna?

English: Oh, I just had a new idea. What if we built a flying city? That'd take at least... a year!
Čeština [cs]: Prave me napadl novy napad. Co kdybychom postavili letajici mesto? To by trvalo alespon… rok!

English: Two plus three times four... uh, sorry what? I'm just thinking about my next rocket ship.
Čeština [cs]: Dva plus tri krat ctyri… ehm, promin, coze? Jen premyslim o sve dalsi rakete.

English: Who would have thought rocket science was so complicated?
Čeština [cs]: Kdo by si pomyslel, ze raketova veda bude tak slozita?

English: It was pretty fun going on a dangerous adventure. Maybe I'll join a scouting mission!
Čeština [cs]: Bylo docela zabavne vydat se na nebezpecne dobrodruzstvi. Mozna se pridam k pruzkumne vyprave!

English: I heard some of the Rafters made it out of Tangaroa. Sanjay should be with them.
Čeština [cs]: Slysel jsem, ze nekteri lide z voru unikli z Tangaroa. Sanjay by mel byt s nimi.

English: He’ll always make it. Good man, Sanjay.
Čeština [cs]: On to vzdycky zvladne. Sanjay je dobrak.

English: I miss Caravan Town. I miss Ma and Pa.
Čeština [cs]: Chybi mi Caravan Town. Chybi mi mama a tata.

English: Utopia is pretty well designed. I could do better though.
Čeština [cs]: Utopie je navrzena docela dobre. Ja bych to ale zvladl lepe.

English: Solar and wind power is cool. Super extreme fission reactors? Cooler.
Čeština [cs]: Solarni a vetrna energie jsou super. Ale superextremni stepne reaktory? Jeste lepsi.

English: Want to hear a secret? Nuclear power is just a glorified steam engine. Don't tell anyone!
Čeština [cs]: Chces slyset tajemstvi? Jaderna energie je jen prehnane vychvalovany parni stroj. Nikomu to nerikej!

English: I'm not scared of anything! Except electromagnetic pulse weapons. They sound spooky.
Čeština [cs]: Nebojim se niceho! Krome zbrani s elektromagnetickym pulzem. Zni desive.

English: Let's create a world free of bad stuff and annoyances. And let's fill it with cool inventions!
Čeština [cs]: Vytvorme svet bez spatnosti a otravnych veci. A naplnme ho skvelymi vynalezy!

English: If I ever invent wings for people, there's only one thing I need to do. Not fly into the sun!
Čeština [cs]: Kdybych nekdy vynalezl kridla pro lidi, musel bych udelat jen jednu vec. Neletet ke slunci!

English: I've heard rumors that rafts work better if you make them look good.
Čeština [cs]: Slysel jsem zvesti, ze vory funguji lepe, kdyz dobre vypadaji.

English: Probably not true. But I'm still going to paint mine in the best colors!
Čeština [cs]: Asi to neni pravda. Ale stejne si ten svuj natru temi nejlepsimi barvami!

English: I want to make a train that runs on the ocean. Just have to invent floating rails. Easy!
Čeština [cs]: Chci postavit vlak, ktery pojede po oceanu. Musim jen vynalezt plovouci koleje. Snadne!

English: I don't get why humans ever built boats. Rafts are so much cooler!
Čeština [cs]: Nechapu, proc lide vubec staveli lode. Vory jsou mnohem lepsi!

English: I feel like everything's going to be alright. With my help, of course!
Čeština [cs]: Mam pocit, ze vsechno dobre dopadne. Samozrejme s mou pomoci!

English: Utopia is my home now. Everyone is really nice here!
Čeština [cs]: Utopie je ted muj domov. Vsichni jsou tu opravdu mili!

English: If we've made it this far, we can go so much further!
Čeština [cs]: Kdyz jsme se dostali az sem, muzeme dojit jeste mnohem dal!

English: You’ve heard about my experiments? Who told you?!
Čeština [cs]: Slysel jsi o mych experimentech? Kdo ti to rekl?!

English: I think Ruben got me a raft because he didn’t want me causing any trouble in the high-rises.
Čeština [cs]: Myslim, ze mi Ruben dal vor, protoze nechtel, abych v mrakodrapech delal potize.

English: Jokes on him, I haven’t even blown up the raft once! So far.
Čeština [cs]: To se mu povedlo! Jeste jsem ten vor ani jednou nevyhodil do vzduchu! Zatim.

English: Hanne keeps going on and on about food and water. It’s easy!
Čeština [cs]: Hanne porad mele o jidle a vode. Je to snadne!

English: We just need to fish without the fish running out.
Čeština [cs]: Staci lovit ryby tak, aby nam nedosly.

English: And build amazing watering systems that never run out of water. Like I said, easy!
Čeština [cs]: A postavit uzasne zavlazovaci systemy, kterym nikdy nedojde voda. Jak rikam, snadne!

English: I have some ideas for an R. I. E. That is, Rocket Iteration Experiment.
Čeština [cs]: Mam par napadu na R. I. E. Tedy Rak etovy Iteracni Experiment.

English: This time we’ll get some serious air time, promise!
Čeština [cs]: Tentokrat se dostaneme poradne vysoko, slibuju!

English: DETTO'S UTOPIA JOURNAL -SUPER SECRET-
Čeština [cs]: DETTOUV DENIK Z UTOPIE – PRISNE TAJNE

English: I have my own raft! And it’s hooked up to actual wind turbines!
Čeština [cs]: Mam vlastni vor! A je pripojeny ke skutecnym vetrnym turbinam!

English: If I had even more power, just imagine all the experiments I could run…
Čeština [cs]: Kdybych mel jeste vic energie, predstavte si vsechny experimenty, ktere bych mohl provadet…

English: But now that lunatic Olof appeared.
Čeština [cs]: Jenze ted se objevil ten silenec Olof.

English: His cages are already unloaded and now he’s promising to help everyone with his ‘army’.
Čeština [cs]: Uz vylozil sve klece a ted slibuje, ze vsem pomuze se svou „armadou“.

English: Last I saw him, Olof Wilkstrom ruined Caravan Town.
Čeština [cs]: Naposledy, kdyz jsem ho videl, Olof Wilkstrom znicil Caravan Town.

English: I will NEVER forgive him! I hope Hanne and Ruben listen to me. He is not to be trusted!
Čeština [cs]: NIKDY mu to neodpustim! Doufam, ze me Hanne a Ruben poslechnou. Neda se mu verit!

English: Just in case I’ve decided to up the security on my raft.
Čeština [cs]: Pro jistotu jsem se rozhodl zvysit zabezpeceni sveho voru.

English: This map should allow only the SMARTEST of people to enter! Like me!
Čeština [cs]: Tato mapa by mela pustit dovnitr jen ty NEJCHYTREJSI! Treba me!

English: When the ocean itself broke civilisation, the survivors were left with nothing.
Čeština [cs]: Kdyz ocean sam znicil civilizaci, prezivsi zustali bez niceho.

English: Yet they persisted, the forward scouts rose up from the wreckage, defied our flooded world, and brought back hope.
Čeština [cs]: Presto vytrvali. Pruzkumnici povstali z trosek, postavili se nasemu zatopenemu svetu a vzdorovali mu.

English: Now Utopia stands free once again thanks to their actions.
Čeština [cs]: Diky jejich cinum je Utopie znovu svobodna.

English: With this final chance we can begin - the slow and difficult road to recovery.
Čeština [cs]: Diky teto posledni sanci muzeme zacit pomalou a obtiznou cestu k obnove.

English: From today on, we are all Forward Scouts, ready to discover the next step for humanity.
Čeština [cs]: Od dnesniho dne jsme vsichni pruzkumnici, pripraveni objevit dalsi krok pro lidstvo.

English: We owe our future to you. Grateful doesn’t even begin to describe it.
Čeština [cs]: Za nasi budoucnost vdecime tobe. Slova vdecnosti ani zdaleka nestaci.

English: Detto will do fine. Despite everything, that boy has a certain spirit in him.
Čeština [cs]: Detto to zvladne. Navzdory vsemu ma ten kluk v sobe urcitou jiskru.

English: It gives me hope for Utopia. For humanity, honestly.
Čeština [cs]: Dava mi to nadeji pro Utopii. A vlastne i pro lidstvo.

English: I heard about the Selene facility.
Čeština [cs]: Slysela jsem o zarizeni Selene.

English: As soon as we’ve stabilized the situation here, we’ll look to finish their ambitions.
Čeština [cs]: Jakmile tu stabilizujeme situaci, pokusime se dokoncit to, o co tam usilovali.

English: Sparrow revealed everything we needed to know.
Čeština [cs]: Sparrow nam prozradil vsechno, co jsme potrebovali vedet.

English: She went off soon after looking for someone called ‘Cuckoo’. We wish her the best.
Čeština [cs]: Brzy pote odesla hledat nekoho, komu rikaji „Kukacka“. Prejeme ji hodne stesti.

English: Hope. Is that what I’m feeling?
Čeština [cs]: Nadeje. Je tohle to, co citim?

English: I’ve waited so long for that moment when we can stop surviving, and start to live.
Čeština [cs]: Tak dlouho jsem cekala na chvili, kdy prestaneme jen prezivat a zacneme skutecne zit.

English: Thank you. Thank you so much.
Čeština [cs]: Dekuji. Moc ti dekuji.

English: Ruben just can’t sit still. Always fixing something. Improving.
Čeština [cs]: Ruben nedokaze chvili posedet. Porad neco opravuje. Vylepsuje.

English: I’d say it was annoying if it didn’t make me smile so much.
Čeština [cs]: Rekla bych, ze je to otravne, kdyby me to tolik nerozesmivalo.

English: If Bruno hadn’t showed up on Temperance, who knows what would have happened.
Čeština [cs]: Kdyby se Bruno neobjevil na Temperance, kdo vi, co by se stalo.

English: Don’t worry, he’s getting the help he needs. It’s the least I can do for him.
Čeština [cs]: Neboj se, dostava potrebnou pomoc. To nejmensi, co pro nej muzu udelat.

English: He’ll find his sister eventually, I’m sure of it.
Čeština [cs]: Jednou svou sestru najde, tim jsem si jista.

English: Bruno sure knows his way around a radio.
Čeština [cs]: Bruno se v radiich opravdu vyzna.

English: He’s already assisted Ruben in fixing up our infrastructure. Invaluable.
Čeština [cs]: Uz pomohl Rubenovi opravit nasi infrastrukturu. Je k nezaplaceni.

English: With the new radios we might even be able to contact other rafters.
Čeština [cs]: S novymi vysilackami bychom mohli navazat kontakt i s dalsimi lidmi na vorech.

English: The Forward Scouts will recover. I know it.
Čeština [cs]: Pruzkumnici se vzpamatuji. Vim to.

English: Who knows, maybe in a few years Utopia will be a true sanctuary for humanity.
Čeština [cs]: Kdo vi, treba bude Utopie za par let skutecnym utocistem lidstva.

English: We just need to focus on the three pillars: food, water, and energy.
Čeština [cs]: Musime se soustredit na tri zakladni veci: jidlo, vodu a energii.

English: If we can keep those stable, peace and prosperity won’t be such strange notions anymore.
Čeština [cs]: Pokud je udrzime stabilni, mir a blahobyt uz nebudou tak cizimi pojmy.

English: We might want to station someone on Balboa Island.
Čeština [cs]: Mozna bychom meli nekoho umistit na ostrov Balboa.

English: It could be a useful stop for any future Forward Scouts. But, yes. The bears might be an issue.
Čeština [cs]: Mohl by se hodit jako zastavka pro budouci pruzkumniky. Ale ano, medvedi by mohli byt problem.

English: Utopia has faced many challenges. Let’s hope the future holds fewer the likes of Olof Wilkstrom.
Čeština [cs]: Utopie celila mnoha vyzvam. Doufejme, ze budoucnost prinese mene lidi, jako je Olof Wilkstrom.

English: We haven’t decided what to do with Olof yet.
Čeština [cs]: Jeste jsme nerozhodli, co s Olofem udelame.

English: Personally I would like to see him work to rebuild what he destroyed.
Čeština [cs]: Osobne bych chtela, aby pomohl obnovit to, co znicil.

English: Learn from his mistakes. Become a better person. But we will see how the vote goes.
Čeština [cs]: Aby se poucil ze svych chyb a stal se lepsim clovekem. Uvidime ale, jak dopadne hlasovani.

English: If you need anything, the people of Utopia are in your service.
Čeština [cs]: Kdybys neco potreboval, obyvatele Utopie jsou ti k sluzbam.

English: Together we will rebuild.
Čeština [cs]: Spolecne vsechno znovu vybudujeme.

English: I regret Vasagatan. But I’ve left it behind long ago.
Čeština [cs]: Mrzi me, co se stalo na Vasagatanu. Ale uz jsem to davno nechala za sebou.

English: I think we all need to do the same, and focus solely on the coming days.
Čeština [cs]: Myslim, ze bychom meli udelat totez a soustredit se jen na nadchazejici dny.

English: I heard what happened on Tangaroa. I can’t imagine seeing the aftermath.
Čeština [cs]: Slysela jsem, co se stalo v Tangaroa. Nedokazu si predstavit, jake to muselo byt videt nasledky.

English: I’m just happy Ruben and Detto made it out alive. Few were so lucky.
Čeština [cs]: Jsem rada, ze Ruben a Detto unikli zivi. Malokdo mel takove stesti.

English: Yes, Detto seems to be fitting in fine. I’ve made sure Ruben keeps an eye on him, but…
Čeština [cs]: Ano, Detto si tu zrejme dobre zvyka. Zajistila jsem, aby na nej Ruben dohlizel, ale…

English: Well, it’s not the easiest task in the world.
Čeština [cs]: No, neni to zrovna nejjednodussi ukol na svete.

English: Soldiers, at arms!
Čeština [cs]: Vojaci, do zbrane!

English: You’ll be court-martialed for that!
Čeština [cs]: Za tohle te postavi pred vojensky soud!

English: You’re weak! Every one of you!
Čeština [cs]: Jste slabi! Vsichni do jednoho!

English: I didn’t create you to be cowards! Forward!
Čeština [cs]: Nevychoval jsem vas, abyste byli zbabelci! Kupredu!

English: Charge!
Čeština [cs]: Do utoku!

English: One bite at a time!
Čeština [cs]: Jedno sousto za druhym!

English: Don’t fear this rabble, fear me!
Čeština [cs]: Nebojte se tehle chatry, bojte se me!

English: One more time, go!
Čeština [cs]: Jeste jednou, do toho!

English: All bark and no bite!
Čeština [cs]: Hodne stekani, ale zadne kousani!

English: You are nothing here.
Čeština [cs]: Tady neznamenate vubec nic.

English: Come on! Get out there, private!
Čeština [cs]: Tak delej! Vypadni tam, vojine!

English: My army of beasts will destroy you!
Čeština [cs]: Moje armada bestii vas znici!

English: If you want to be fed, do your jobs!
Čeština [cs]: Jestli chcete dostavat jidlo, delejte svou praci!

English: Keep fighting!
Čeština [cs]: Bojujte dal!

English: A warrior’s bloodthirst never ends.
Čeština [cs]: Valecnikova touha po krvi nikdy nekonci.

English: Don’t back down!
Čeština [cs]: Neustupujte!

English: Soon there’ll be a feast!
Čeština [cs]: Brzy bude hostina!

English: You’re nothing but chew toys for my army.
Čeština [cs]: Pro mou armadu jste jen hracky na zvykani.

English: Useless! All of you!
Čeština [cs]: K nicemu! Vsichni do jednoho!

English: This will be your END!
Čeština [cs]: Tohle bude vas KONEC!

English: How stupid are you? I am the only reason any of you are alive.
Čeština [cs]: Jak jste hloupi? Jsem jediny duvod, proc jste jeste nazivu.

English: Me. I made this place real. My investment. Mine.
Čeština [cs]: Ja. Ja jsem tohle misto promenil ve skutecnost. Moje investice. Moje vlastnictvi.

English: Each and every one of you should bow down before me.
Čeština [cs]: Kazdy z vas by se prede mnou mel poklonit.

English: The ocean broke the Forward Scouts. Now my army will finish the job.
Čeština [cs]: Ocean zlomil pruzkumniky. Ted mou armadu dokonci praci.

English: So annoying.
Čeština [cs]: To je tak otravne.

English: I’m a trader. I was only here to move some produce.
Čeština [cs]: Jsem obchodnik. Byl jsem tu jen kvuli preprave zbozi.

English: Then, boom! Rabid hyenas everywhere!
Čeština [cs]: A pak bum! Vsude vztekle hyeny!

English: All of a sudden, I’m locked in!
Čeština [cs]: A najednou jsem zavreny!

English: Worst part, Olof ruined a bunch of my goods. Prick.
Čeština [cs]: A co je nejhorsi, Olof znicil spoustu meho zbozi. Hajzl.

English: It's over now. But boy was that close!
Čeština [cs]: Ted uz je po vsem. Ale to bylo o fous!

English: I tried to deal with those hounds at first.
Čeština [cs]: Nejdriv jsem se pokusil vyporadat s temi ohari.

English: But there were too many of them.
Čeština [cs]: Bylo jich ale prilis mnoho.

English: We’re lucky no one got seriously hurt.
Čeština [cs]: Mame stesti, ze se nikomu nestalo nic vazneho.

English: Oh, this? It’s just a scratch, don’t worry.
Čeština [cs]: Tohle? To je jen skrabnuti, neboj.

English: I’m so unlucky!
Čeština [cs]: Ja mam ale smulu!

English: I fled Tangaroa during the riots. Such a crazy day.
Čeština [cs]: Behem nepokoju jsem utekl z Tangaroa. To byl sileny den.

English: Then I found Utopia. And this whole thing happened.
Čeština [cs]: Pak jsem nasel Utopii. A stalo se tohle.

English: I just want to tend to a garden in peace. Maybe I can do that now!
Čeština [cs]: Chci jen v klidu pecovat o zahradu. Mozna to ted konecne pujde!

English: Leaving already?
Čeština [cs]: Uz odchazis?

English: The ocean’s wider than ever and there’s always more to explore.
Čeština [cs]: Ocean je sirsi nez kdy driv a porad je co objevovat.

English: I’d love to head out one day. See what’s left of the world.
Čeština [cs]: Jednou bych se rad vydal na cestu a podival se, co ze sveta zbylo.

English: Good luck out there.
Čeština [cs]: Hodne stesti na cestach.

English: I can’t believe we ended up like that.
Čeština [cs]: Nemuzu uverit, ze to takhle dopadlo.

English: Listening to Olof was a mistake to say the least.
Čeština [cs]: Poslouchat Olofa byla prinejmensim chyba.

English: I need to get better at reading people.
Čeština [cs]: Musim se zlepsit v odhadovani lidi.

English: In hindsight, yes. Olof did seem a bit maniacal.
Čeština [cs]: Kdyz se na to podivam zpetne, Olof opravdu pusobil trochu jako maniak.

English: Don’t worry, I’m disappointed in myself too.
Čeština [cs]: Neboj, sam ze sebe jsem zklamany taky.

English: Good boy, Alpha! Good boy!
Čeština [cs]: Hodny kluk, Alpho! Hodny kluk!

English: Kill.
Čeština [cs]: Zabij!

English: You and all the other disgusting rafters will pay.
Čeština [cs]: Ty i vsichni ostatni odporni lide z voru za to zaplatite.

English: I am the only one who can fulfill this role.
Čeština [cs]: Jedine ja dokazu tuto roli naplnit.

English: Can’t you see? The rafters would see this Utopia in ruins.
Čeština [cs]: Copak to nevidite? Lide z voru by Utopii privedli do ruin.

English: I will rise above you all.
Čeština [cs]: Povznesu se nad vas vsechny.

English: Your struggle ends here!
Čeština [cs]: Vas boj zde konci!

English: I will bring order to this damn place, whether you want it or not!
Čeština [cs]: Zavedu na tomhle zatracenem miste poradek, at chcete, nebo ne!

English: It’s useless! His hide is thick, and his will is iron!
Čeština [cs]: Je to marne! Ma tlustou kuzi a zeleznou vuli!

English: A true soldier never falters.
Čeština [cs]: Opravdovy vojak nikdy nezavaha.

English: Alpha! Get going!
Čeština [cs]: Alpho! Do toho!

English: You can gnaw on their bones later!
Čeština [cs]: Jejich kosti muzes ohlodat pozdeji!

English: You’ll get a real treat once victory is ours!
Čeština [cs]: Az zvitezime, ceka te poradna odmena!

English: Charge, Alpha, charge!
Čeština [cs]: Do toho, Alpho, do utoku!

English: Destroy them!
Čeština [cs]: Znicte je!

English: You’re the only one I can trust, Alpha.
Čeština [cs]: Jsi jediny, komu muzu verit, Alpho.

English: No, no! Alpha, you failure!
Čeština [cs]: Ne, ne! Alpho, ty neschopaku!

English: All of this for nothing!
Čeština [cs]: To vsechno bylo k nicemu!

English: Out of all my creations, Alpha is a true warrior. A survivor.
Čeština [cs]: Ze vsech mych vytvoru je Alfa opravdovy valecnik. Prezivsi.

English: You see, the weak are singled out. The strong remain. You Forward Scouts were the same.
Čeština [cs]: Slabi jsou vyrazeni. Silni zustavaji. Vy, pruzkumnici z predvoje, jste na tom byli stejne.

English: You build yourselves up from nothing. You keep going. Up until you encounter something stronger.
Čeština [cs]: Vybudujete se z niceho. Pokracujete dal. Dokud nenarazite na neco silnejsiho.

English: Alpha, in position! Kill!
Čeština [cs]: Alfo, na misto! Zabij!

English: Tactical retreat! Regroup, regroup!
Čeština [cs]: Takticky ustup! Preskupit, preskupit!

English: Infantry! Ready for charge!
Čeština [cs]: Pechoto! Pripravit se k utoku!

English: You had your chance to leave.
Čeština [cs]: Mel jsi moznost odejit.

English: But you just won't listen.
Čeština [cs]: Ale ty proste neposlouchas.

English: So fine. Have it your way! Welcome to Utopia!
Čeština [cs]: Tak dobre. Jak chces! Vitej v Utopii!

English: Frag out!
Čeština [cs]: Granat leti!

English: Stand still!
Čeština [cs]: Ani se nehni!

English: I’ll lock you up with the rest!
Čeština [cs]: Zavru te mezi ostatni!

English: This rabble deserves nothing.
Čeština [cs]: Tahle chatra si nic nezaslouzi.

English: If you knew better you would turn around.
Čeština [cs]: Kdybys mel rozum, otocil by ses a odesel.

English: My army will crush you!
Čeština [cs]: Moje armada te rozdrti!

English: I could do this all day!
Čeština [cs]: Tohle bych mohl delat cely den!

English: Do you want me to blow it all to pieces?
Čeština [cs]: Chces, abych to vsechno rozmetal na kusy?

English: Look what you’re making me do!
Čeština [cs]: Podivej, k cemu me nutis!

English: Leave Utopia! Never return!
Čeština [cs]: Opust Utopii! Uz se nevracej!

English: I’ve given you chances. You could have left at any time!
Čeština [cs]: Daval jsem ti sance. Mohl jsi kdykoli odejit!

English: Enjoy the fireworks!
Čeština [cs]: Uzij si ohnostroj!

English: All of this is mine!
Čeština [cs]: Tohle vsechno patri mne!

English: Give up!
Čeština [cs]: Vzdej to!

English: You think it’s easy to rule?
Čeština [cs]: Myslis, ze je snadne vladnout?

English: You’ll accomplish nothing here. Leave!
Čeština [cs]: Tady niceho nedosahnes. Odejdete!

English: Stop that.
Čeština [cs]: Prestan!

English: Why can’t you listen? None of you ever listen!
Čeština [cs]: Proc neposlouchas? Nikdo z vas nikdy neposloucha!

English: Wow, how could this possibly have happened?
Čeština [cs]: Pani, jak se tohle vubec mohlo stat?

English: A mysterious army dude appears with rabid hyenas in cages.
Čeština [cs]: Objevi se zahadny chlapek z armady a priveze vztekle hyeny v klecich.

English: And everyone just goes along with it.
Čeština [cs]: A vsichni to proste prijmou.

English: I don’t think I can say ‘I told you so’ enough.
Čeština [cs]: Myslim, ze „ja vam to rikal“ jsem uz rekl dostkrat.

English: We need to be more careful in the future.
Čeština [cs]: Priste musime byt opatrnejsi.

English: Olof happened because we were naive.
Čeština [cs]: Za Olofovo radeni muze nase naivita.

English: So we should be more vigilant in the future.
Čeština [cs]: Priste tedy musime byt ostrazitejsi.

English: But we also can’t lose what makes Utopia great.
Čeština [cs]: Nesmime ale ztratit to, co dela Utopii skvelym mistem.

English: We need to be strong, and not let fear guide us.
Čeština [cs]: Musime byt silni a nenechat se vest strachem.

English: Those hyenas were so rude.
Čeština [cs]: Ty hyeny byly pekne drze.

English: Bad enough we have to deal with an endless ocean.
Čeština [cs]: Jako by nestacilo, ze se musime vyporadat s nekonecnym oceanem.

English: Now there’s these rabid animals also.
Čeština [cs]: A ted k tomu jeste ty vztekle bestie.

English: Ugh. So tired of this!
Čeština [cs]: Ach jo. Uz me to nebavi!

English: Oh right, thanks for helping out.
Čeština [cs]: Jo, vlastne diky za pomoc.

English: Look around. The filthy rafters turned luxury apartments into a scrapyard.
Čeština [cs]: Rozhledni se. Ti spinavi obyvatele voru promenili luxusni byty ve smetiste.

English: Relieving them of the responsibility was the only decent thing I could do for them.
Čeština [cs]: Zbavit je te odpovednosti bylo to jedine slusne, co jsem pro ne mohl udelat.

English: I can’t believe how ungrateful all of you are.
Čeština [cs]: Nemuzu uverit, jak jste vsichni nevdecni.

English: [Groaning]
Čeština [cs]: [Stenani]

English: Cut me down!
Čeština [cs]: Pustte me dolu!

English: Listen to me, damn it.
Čeština [cs]: Poslouchejte me, sakra!

English: [Muttering]
Čeština [cs]: [Nesrozumitelne mumlani]

English: I’ll burn this place to the ground
Čeština [cs]: Spalim tohle misto do zakladu.

English: You don’t deserve any of it.
Čeština [cs]: Nic z toho si nezaslouzite.

English: Filthy rafters.
Čeština [cs]: Spinavi vorovici.

English: Are you happy now?
Čeština [cs]: Ted jste spokojeni?

English: Nothing you fools can come up with will rival what came before.
Čeština [cs]: Nic, s cim prijdete, se nevyrovna tomu, co tu bylo predtim.

English: Hey, are you listening to me?!
Čeština [cs]: Hej, poslouchas me?!

English: The Floating City Project was wrought with failures. Why? I spent a fortune on Tangaroa.
Čeština [cs]: Projekt plovoucich mest byl od zacatku plny problemu. Proc? Do Tangaroa jsem investoval cele jmeni.

English: Every expert told me we were on schedule. How do you explain that?
Čeština [cs]: Kazdy odbornik mi tvrdil, ze jsme podle planu. Jak to vysvetlite?

English: Lazy workers. Lazy, stupid workers.
Čeština [cs]: Lini delnici. Line, hloupe delnictvo.

English: I was the majority shareholder of the Floating City Project of Tangaroa.
Čeština [cs]: Byl jsem vetsinovym akcionarem projektu Plovouciho mesta v Tangaroa.

English: Imagine the cost if we hadn’t made it out to sea, like the other cities? No, that wasn’t an option.
Čeština [cs]: Predstavte si ty naklady, kdybychom se nedostali na more jako ostatni mesta. Ne, to neprichazelo v uvahu.

English: I did not abandon Tangaroa. My private consultants made it very clear.
Čeština [cs]: Tangaroa jsem neopustil. Moji soukromi poradci mi jasne vysvetlili, co je treba udelat.

English: The city wouldn’t last a year out at sea.
Čeština [cs]: To mesto by na mori nevydrzelo ani rok.

English: Vasagatan was my way of saving a few souls from that fate.
Čeština [cs]: Vasagatan byl muj zpusob, jak zachranit alespon nekolik dusi pred stejnym osudem.

English: They would have drowned anyway.
Čeština [cs]: Stejne by se utopili.

English: I am a good man. I am a good man.
Čeština [cs]: Jsem dobry clovek. Jsem dobry clovek.

English: The Lurkers weren’t entirely useless.
Čeština [cs]: Cihaci nebyli uplne k nicemu.

English: They wrought chaos onboard Tangaroa.
Čeština [cs]: Na palube Tangaroa zpusobili chaos.

English: Any decent fighting force could have brought order within a day or two.
Čeština [cs]: Kazda slusna bojova jednotka by tam dokazala nastolit poradek za den nebo dva.

English: None of them were ready for reality. When there’s only food for one in ten, nine have to go.
Čeština [cs]: Nikdo z nich nebyl pripraven na realitu. Kdyz je jidlo jen pro jednoho z deseti, devet musi pryc.

English: The hyenas of Caravan Town were easily rounded up.
Čeština [cs]: Hyeny z Caravan Town se podarilo snadno pochytat.

English: Their efficiency and discipline was unrivaled.
Čeština [cs]: Jejich efektivita a disciplina nemely obdoby.

English: Had I only gotten a few more off that barren rock, then you would have never stood a chance.
Čeština [cs]: Kdybych jich z te puste skaly dostal jen o par vic, nemeli byste vubec sanci.

English: If you hadn’t interfered, I would be out there reinstating law and order.
Čeština [cs]: Kdybys mi neprekazil plany, byl bych tam venku a znovu nastoloval zakon a poradek.

English: Have you ever done anything of such importance?
Čeština [cs]: Dokazal jsi nekdy neco tak duleziteho?

English: These idiots won’t get anything done. They’ll starve soon, and so will you.
Čeština [cs]: Tihle idioti nic nezvladnou. Brzy zemrou hlady, a ty taky.

English: Yes, we all heard about the failure of the Forward Scouts.
Čeština [cs]: Ano, vsichni jsme slyseli o neuspechu pruzkumniku z predvoje.

English: Those naive idiots couldn’t even beat the waves. What, you think you’re any different?
Čeština [cs]: Ti naivni idioti nedokazali porazit ani vlny. Co, myslis, ze jsi jiny?

English: Look at these people. They have no control. No power. They need me.
Čeština [cs]: Podivej se na ty lidi. Nemaji zadnou kontrolu ani moc. Potrebuji me.

English: Disorganized rabble.
Čeština [cs]: Neorganizovana chatra.

English: You need a strong leader. Not these weaklings.
Čeština [cs]: Potrebujete silneho vudce. Ne tyhle slabochy.

English: This is what I get for trusting my army.
Čeština [cs]: Tohle mam za to, ze jsem duveroval sve armade.

English: If you have to do something, do it yourself.
Čeština [cs]: Kdyz chces neco udelat, udelej to sam.

English: They don’t have the guts to rule.
Čeština [cs]: Nemaji odvahu vladnout.

English: It’s the same story over and over again. The floating city project. Vasagatan. Tangaroa.
Čeština [cs]: Porad se opakuje ten samy pribeh. Projekt plovoucich mest. Vasagatan. Tangaroa.

English: Failures brought on by weak spirits and undisciplined men.
Čeština [cs]: Neuspechy zpusobene slabou vuli a nedisciplinovanymi muzi.

English: You’re nothing but beasts in the rubble.
Čeština [cs]: Nejste nic nez zvirata mezi troskami.

English: Get back!
Čeština [cs]: Get Zpet!

English: There’s nothing you can do. Stay away. All of this is mine.
Čeština [cs]: Nemuzete nic delat. Drzte se dal. Tohle vsechno je moje.

English: You think you can change anything?
Čeština [cs]: Myslis, ze muzes neco zmenit?

English: Without me, this Utopia will burn.
Čeština [cs]: Beze me tahle Utopie shori.

English: I am your saviour!
Čeština [cs]: Ja jsem vas spasitel!

English: Stay away!
Čeština [cs]: Drzte se dal!

English: I will only say this once. Leave on your raft. Leave Utopia to me.
Čeština [cs]: Reknu to jen jednou. Odpluj na svem voru. Utopii nech mne.

English: Or else the Forward Scouts ends with you.
Čeština [cs]: Jinak pruzkumnici z predvoje skonci spolu s tebou.

English: This place is a mess.
Čeština [cs]: Tohle misto je naprosty neporadek.

English: There’s hyena hair everywhere!
