Čeština [cs]: Uklid vezi potrva cele dny.

English: I hope the council makes Olof clean it up himself.
Čeština [cs]: Doufam, ze rada prinuti Olofa, aby to uklidil sam.

English: The future is bright!
Čeština [cs]: Budoucnost vypada slibne!

English: I was so scared Utopia would fall into ruin after this incident.
Čeština [cs]: Bal jsem se, ze se Utopie po tomhle incidentu promeni v ruiny.

English: Now I'm hopeful again.
Čeština [cs]: Ted zase doufam v lepsi zitrky.

English: We can do it! We can rebuild!
Čeština [cs]: Dokazeme to! Znovu to vybudujeme!

English: You deserve all the credit in the world.
Čeština [cs]: Zaslouzis si veskere uznani na svete.

English: You know, I was almost a Forward Scout myself.
Čeština [cs]: Vis, malem jsem se sam stal pruzkumnikem z predvoje.

English: Ended up as working in a raft town instead.
Čeština [cs]: Nakonec jsem misto toho skoncil v osade na vorech.

English: But I’ll tell you, I’m a really good at building rafts.
Čeština [cs]: Ale povim ti, ze stavet vory opravdu umim.

English: Used to build boats before the flood. Wasn’t as fun, if I’m honest.
Čeština [cs]: Pred potopou jsem stavel lode. Uprimne, nebyla to takova zabava.

English: Rafts are magical in their own way, don't you agree?
Čeština [cs]: Vory maji sve vlastni kouzlo, nemyslis?

English: There is something deeply wrong with those hyenas.
Čeština [cs]: S temi hyenami je neco opravdu spatne.

English: I lived on Temperance for a bit. As a researcher.
Čeština [cs]: Nejakou dobu jsem zila na Temperance jako vyzkumnice.

English: Olof’s hyenas seem to be afflicted by some kind of rapid mutation.
Čeština [cs]: Zda se, ze Olofovy hyeny trpi nejakou rychlou mutaci.

English: I’ll be sure to investigate on behalf of the council.
Čeština [cs]: Jmenem rady to urcite prosetrim.

English: This place is a mess.
Čeština [cs]: Tohle misto je naprosty neporadek.

English: There’s hyena hair everywhere!
Čeština [cs]: Vsude jsou chlupy z hyen!

English: It’s you!
Čeština [cs]: To jsi ty!

Čeština [cs]: Nevim, co bychom si bez tebe pocali.

English: Thank you, Forward Scout.
Čeština [cs]: Dekujeme ti, pruzkumniku z predvoje.

English: We can go back to normal now.
Čeština [cs]: Ted se muzeme vratit k normalnimu zivotu.

English:
Varuna Point has all too many holes in it. Makes it easy to move unnoticed.

Today I nicked a hammer. Yesterday I took some dried meat from the foreman’s stash. It’s less fun taking food, since it spoils, eventually.  The watch I got from the loud-mouthed driller was way more exciting.

I want to grab something even better tonight.
Čeština [cs]: Varuna Point ma az prilis mnoho der. Diky tomu se tu da snadno pohybovat, aniz by si me nekdo vsiml.Dnes jsem stipl kladivo. Vcera jsem vzal trochu suseneho masa z predakovy skryse. Krast jidlo neni takova zabava, protoze se nakonec zkazi. Hodinky, ktere jsem sebral tomu ukecanemu vrtari, byly mnohem zajimavejsi.Dnes vecer chci ukrast neco jeste lepsiho.~Zlodej

English:
I heard them talking about me this morning. They call me the Grabber. It’s growing on me.

I moved my cache. It’s higher up now, on the new floor. Right under their noses. The foreman complained about the lack of cameras. Ha! Like that’d matter. I wouldn’t get caught even if the walls had eyes.

I’m starting to get good at this.
~The Grabber
Čeština [cs]: Dnes rano jsem zaslechl, jak o mne mluvi. Rikaji mi Zlodej. Zacina se mi to jmeno libit.Presunul jsem svou skrys. Ted je vys, v novem patre. Primo pred jejich nosem. Predak si stezoval, ze tu nejsou kamery. Cha! Jako by na tom zalezelo. Nechytili by me, ani kdyby mely zdi oci.Zacinam byt v tomhle opravdu dobry.~Zlodej

English:
We don’t work on new floors anymore. Everyone is scared of "the Grabber". There’s talk about leaving before ''the water gets even higher''.  Leaving for that other construction project, the one taken over by rafters. They call it Utopia.

Ha! The only utopia I need is right here! I’ve started to secure the tower. As long as I live no one will claim my treasure. No one will reach my nest!
~The Grabber
Čeština [cs]: Na novych patrech uz nepracujeme. Vsichni se boji „Zlodeje“. Mluvi se o odchodu, nez „voda jeste vic stoupne“. Chteji odejit na jiny stavebni projekt, ktery prevzali lide z voru. Rikaji mu Utopie.Cha! Jedinou utopii, kterou potrebuji, mam tady! Zacal jsem vez zabezpecovat. Dokud ziju, nikdo si muj poklad nevezme. Nikdo se nedostane do meho hnizda!~Zlodej

English:
When people come by they don’t stay for long. Why? Probably because I keep stealing their stuff…

Today it was a man named Ruben and a boy named Detto. They were caught in a storm and needed supplies. When they fell asleep I nicked a whole set of tools. Crude stuff. But still good!
In the morning they were so freaked out they sailed away immediately. Hilarious!
~The Grabber
Čeština [cs]: Kdyz sem nekdo zavita, dlouho se nezdrzi. Proc? Nejspis proto, ze jim porad kradu veci…Dnes to byl muz jmenem Ruben a chlapec jmenem Detto. Zastihla je boure a potrebovali zasoby. Kdyz usnuli, stipl jsem jim celou sadu naradi. Nic moc, ale porad se hodi!Rano byli tak vydeseni, ze okamzite odpluli. To byla legrace!~Zlodej

English:
A man talking to dolls arrived yesterday. I found his loud discussions entertaining. Maybe I miss company a bit too.

The man climbed high up into the crane with a satellite dish. He called out on his little radio for ‘Astrid’. It looked… unsuccessful.

I might have… stolen one of his dolls. ‘Miranda’ is her name. The man left an hour ago, after freaking out all day over it! Ha! So many strange people these days.
~The Grabber
Čeština [cs]: Vcera dorazil muz, ktery mluvil s panenkami. Jeho hlasite rozhovory me bavily. Mozna mi take trochu chybi spolecnost.Muz vysplhal vysoko do jerabu se satelitni antenou. Do sve male vysilacky volal „Astrid“. Vypadalo to… neuspesne.Mozna jsem mu… ukradl jednu panenku. Jmenuje se „Miranda“. Muz odplul pred hodinou, pote co kvuli ni cely den silel! Cha! V posledni dobe je tu tolik podivnych lidi.~Zlodej

English:
I would be bored these days, if the ‘motherlode’ wasn’t on the forefront of my mind. The water stole it from me. I should’ve acted sooner. 

Now there’s trouble in the way. It’s risky to deal with, but it might be worth it. The thought gnaws at me.

But it’s just one shark. How hard could it be?
~The Grabber
Čeština [cs]: Posledni dobou bych se nudil, kdybych porad nemyslel na „poklad“. Voda mi ho vzala. Mel jsem jednat driv.Ted mi stoji v ceste problem. Bude riskantni ho vyresit, ale mozna to stoji za to. Ta myslenka me hloda.Je to ale jen jeden zralok. Jak tezke to muze byt?~Zlodej

English:
I heard from the captain we’re heading for one of the high-rises down south. I can only hope you come to your senses and follow us.

You knew the city was a failure, Ruben. Why do you always have to be so stubborn? 
~Hanne
Čeština [cs]: Od kapitana jsem slysela, ze mirime k jednomu z vyskovych domu na jihu. Muzu jen doufat, ze prijdes k rozumu a pridas se k nam.Vedel jsi, ze mesto je ztracene, Rubene. Proc musis byt vzdycky tak tvrdohlavy?~Hanne

English:
Ruben,

The yacht is ill prepared for this journey. Olof left space for a dance floor, but no space for supplies. The bottles sure found their way to the bar. As a military man I thought Olof would at the very least be practical. Yet they’re all treating it like a luxury cruise.

I’m sorry, Ruben. I shouldn't have left.
~Hanne
Čeština [cs]: Rubene,Jachta neni na tuhle cestu vubec pripravena. Olof nechal misto na tanecni parket, ale ne na zasoby. Lahve si cestu do baru nasly bez problemu. Jako vojak jsem si myslela, ze Olof bude alespon trochu prakticky. Vsichni se ale chovaji, jako by byli na luxusni plavbe.Promin, Rubene. Nemela jsem odchazet.~Hanne

English:
I saw a large rat last night… Unnervingly large. I tried telling the crew we obviously have an infestation among the locked down supplies. They laughed at me.

I miss you, Ruben.
~Hanne
Čeština [cs]: Vcera v noci jsem videla velkou krysu… Neprijemne velkou. Snazila jsem se posadce vysvetlit, ze mezi uzamcenymi zasobami ocividne mame zamoreni. Smali se mi.Chybis mi, Rubene.~Hanne

English:
calling the cost of the project’s realization “borderline criminal” and its scope “outrageous, at least”. Despite vocal opposition, the Floating Cities Project does not appear to be slowing down anytime soon. According to former General Olof Wilkstrom’s latest statement on the issue:

“We are fully aware of the strain this puts on our people. Nevertheless, our options are becoming increasingly limited. We must pull through this together or join Stockholm beneath the waves.”
Čeština [cs]: …oznacil naklady na uskutecneni projektu za „temer kriminalni“ a jeho rozsah prinejmensim za „nehorazny“. Navzdory hlasitemu odporu se nezda, ze by projekt Plovoucich mest mel v dohledne dobe zpomalit. Podle nejnovejsiho vyjadreni byvaleho generala Olofa Wilkstroma k teto zalezitosti:„Plne si uvedomujeme, jakou zatez to pro nase lidi predstavuje. Nase moznosti se vsak stale vice omezuji. Musime to spolecne zvladnout, nebo se pripojime ke Stockholmu pod hladinou.“

English: "We must pull through this together or join Stockholm beneath the waves."
Čeština [cs]: „Musime to spolecne zvladnout, nebo se pripojit ke Stockholmu pod hladinou.“

English: Wilkstrom refused to comment on the rumors regarding the modification of his personal yacht. When further asked about the Floating City Project’s whistle blowers, Olof Wilkstrom chose to terminate the interview. Reaching out to these anonymous sources we were able to further corroborate -
Čeština [cs]: Wilkstrom odmitl komentovat zvesti o upravach sve soukrome jachty. Kdyz se ho novinari dale ptali na oznamovatele z projektu Plovoucich mest, Olof Wilkstrom rozhovor ukoncil. Po kontaktovani techto anonymnich zdroju se nam podarilo potvrdit dalsi informace –

English: Factbox
Čeština [cs]: Informacni box

English: CITIES IN THE BLUE
Čeština [cs]: MESTA V MODRI

English:
The captain keeps complaining about my route. If he does it again he will be reprimanded. 

The crew doesn’t listen to orders. I’m shocked by their undisciplined nature. Somehow they believe rank and prestige disappeared with solid land. No, they will not be allowed to mingle among my esteemed guests. And they will certainly not be allowed further rations. 

They should be grateful. I am the only reason they are alive.
~Olof Wilkstrom
Čeština [cs]: Kapitan si neustale stezuje na mou trasu. Pokud to udela znovu, bude potrestan.Posadka neposloucha rozkazy. Jsem sokovan jejich nedisciplinovanosti. Nejak se domnivaji, ze hodnost a prestiz zmizely spolu s pevnou zemi. Ne, mezi me vazene hosty se michat nebudou. A rozhodne nedostanou dalsi pridely.Meli by byt vdecni. Jsem jediny duvod, proc jsou jeste nazivu.~Olof Wilkstrom

English:
As I’ve suspected the crew is completely incompetent. Now they’re claiming RATS have eaten half of our supplies in a matter of weeks. I promised them increased rations if they could bring me one of these ridiculous ‘lurkers’ alive.

Of course, the food shortage will need to be handled. Tonight we’re discussing which staff members are most suitable for termination.
~Olof Wilkstrom
Čeština [cs]: Jak jsem predpokladal, posadka je naprosto neschopna. Ted tvrdi, ze KRYsy behem nekolika tydnu sezraly polovinu nasich zasob. Slibil jsem jim vetsi pridely, pokud mi prinesou jednoho z tech smesnych „cihacu“ ziveho.Nedostatek jidla bude samozrejme nutne vyresit. Dnes vecer probereme, ktere zamestnance bude nejvhodnejsi propustit.~Olof Wilkstrom

English:
These ‘lurkers’ have potential. They were clearly once rats, now grown into something much more rabid. Yet also smarter.

I’ve already made progress on their training. With food and pain as incentives I can discipline them. And by sharing their blood the mutations increase. I wonder if another species would react the same? I’ve received a transmission from a place called Caravan Town not far from here.

They have an active animal population. No longer do I need this make-shift crew. I will create true soldiers. Loyal soldiers.
~Olof Wilkstrom
Čeština [cs]: Ti „cihaci“ maji potencial. Zjevne to kdysi byly krysy, ktere se vyvinuly v neco mnohem zurivejsiho, ale take chytrejsiho.S jejich vycvikem jsem uz pokrocil. Pomoci jidla a bolesti je dokazu ukaznit. Sdilenim jejich krve se mutace dale prohlubuji. Zajimalo by me, zda by stejne reagoval i jiny druh. Zachytil jsem vysilani z mista zvaneho Caravan Town, ktere neni daleko.Maji tam aktivni populaci zvirat. Tuhle provizorni posadku uz nepotrebuji. Vytvorim skutecne vojaky. Verne vojaky.~Olof Wilkstrom

(Hanne) - “That’s one of those damn rats! What are you doing to it?”

Čeština [cs]: „Plne si uvedomujeme, jakou zatez to pro nase lidi predstavuje.“

English: Nevertheless, our options are becoming increasingly limited.
Čeština [cs]: Presto se nase moznosti stale vice zuzuji.

English: We must pull through this together or join Stockholm beneath the waves.”
Čeština [cs]: Musime to spolecne zvladnout, nebo se pripojime ke Stockholmu pod hladinou.“

English: Wilkstrom refused to comment on the rumors regarding the modification of his personal yacht.
Čeština [cs]: Wilkstrom odmitl komentovat zvesti o upravach sve soukrome jachty.

English: When further asked about the Floating City Project’s whistle blowers, Olof Wilkstrom chose to terminate the interview.
Čeština [cs]: Kdyz se ho nasledne zeptali na informatory projektu Plovoucich mest, Olof Wilkstrom rozhovor ukoncil.

English: Reaching out to these anonymous sources we were able to further corroborate -
Čeština [cs]: Kdyz jsme kontaktovali tyto anonymni zdroje, podarilo se nam dale potvrdit –

English: The captain keeps complaining about my route. If he does it again he will be reprimanded.
Čeština [cs]: Kapitan si neustale stezuje na mou trasu. Pokud to udela znovu, bude pokaran.

English: The crew doesn’t listen to orders. I’m shocked by their undisciplined nature.
Čeština [cs]: Posadka neposloucha rozkazy. Jsem sokovan jejich nedisciplinovanosti.

English: Somehow they believe rank and prestige disappeared with solid land.
Čeština [cs]: Nejak se domnivaji, ze s pevninou zmizely i hodnosti a prestiz.

English: No, they will not be allowed to mingle among my esteemed guests.
Čeština [cs]: Ne, mezi me vazene hosty se rozhodne michat nebudou.

English: And they will certainly not be allowed further rations.
Čeština [cs]: A rozhodne nedostanou ani dalsi pridely.

English: They should be grateful. I am the only reason they are alive.
Čeština [cs]: Meli by byt vdecni. Jsem jediny duvod, proc jsou jeste nazivu.

English: As I’ve suspected the crew is completely incompetent.
Čeština [cs]: Jak jsem predpokladal, posadka je naprosto neschopna.

English: Now they’re claiming RATS have eaten half of our supplies in a matter of weeks.
Čeština [cs]: Ted tvrdi, ze krysy behem nekolika tydnu sezraly polovinu nasich zasob.

English: I promised them increased rations if they could bring me one of these ridiculous ‘lurkers’ alive.
Čeština [cs]: Slibil jsem jim vetsi pridely, pokud mi prinesou jednoho z tech smesnych „cihacu“ ziveho.

English: Of course, the food shortage will need to be handled.
Čeština [cs]: Samozrejme bude nutne vyresit nedostatek jidla.

English: Tonight we’re discussing which staff members are most suitable for termination.
Čeština [cs]: Dnes vecer budeme probirat, ktere zamestnance je nejvhodnejsi propustit.

English: These ‘lurkers’ have potential.
Čeština [cs]: Tihle „cihaci“ maji potencial.

English: They were clearly once rats, now grown into something much more rabid. Yet also smarter.
Čeština [cs]: Kdysi to ocividne byly obycejne krysy, ale ted vyrostly v neco mnohem zurivejsiho. A take chytrejsiho.

English: I’ve already made progress on their training. With food and pain as incentives I can discipline them.
Čeština [cs]: S jejich vycvikem jsem uz pokrocil. Pomoci jidla a bolesti je dokazu ukaznit.

English: And by sharing their blood the mutations increase. I wonder if another species would react the same?
Čeština [cs]: Sdilenim jejich krve se mutace zesiluji. Zajimalo by me, zda by stejne reagoval i jiny druh.

English: I’ve received a transmission from a place called Caravan Town not far from here.
Čeština [cs]: Zachytil jsem vysilani z mista jmenem Mesto karavan, nedaleko odsud.

English: They have an active animal population. No longer do I need this make-shift crew. I will create true soldiers. Loyal soldiers.
Čeština [cs]: Maji tam aktivni populaci zvirat. Tuto provizorni posadku uz nepotrebuji. Vytvorim skutecne vojaky. Verne vojaky.

English: (Hanne) - “But what does that mean? You can’t just fire them. We’re out at sea!”
Čeština [cs]: (Hanne) – „Co to ma znamenat? Nemuzes je jen tak vyhodit. Jsme prece na mori!“

English: (Olof) - “Hanne, you were brought to keep the engines running. That is what you-”
Čeština [cs]: (Olof) – „Hanne, privedli jsme te sem, abys udrzovala motory v chodu. A prave to ty—“

English: (Lurker) - *Rabid noises.*
Čeština [cs]: (Cihac) – *Zurive zvuky.*

English: (Hanne) - “That’s one of those damn rats! What… what are you doing to it?”
Čeština [cs]: (Hanne) – „To je jedna z tech zatracenych krys! Co… co s ni delas?“

English: (Olof) - “Get out. Do your job.”
Čeština [cs]: (Olof) – „Vypadni. Delej svou praci.“

English: (Captain) - *Knocking* “Wilkstrom, it’s urgent. There’s mist now. We don’t know how far the water’s risen. The maps are useless. We need to-”
Čeština [cs]: (Kapitan) – *Zaklepani* „Wilkstrome, je to nalehave. Objevila se mlha. Nevime, jak vysoko uz voda stoupla. Mapy jsou k nicemu. Musime—“

English: (Olof) - “The crew are planning a mutiny, Captain. It is time to act.”
Čeština [cs]: (Olof) – „Kapitane, posadka planuje vzpouru. Je cas jednat.“

English: (Captain) - “A mutiny? They’re just trying to stay alive, I- Are you mad?”
Čeština [cs]: (Kapitan) – „Vzpouru? Jen se snazi prezit, ja— Zblaznil ses?“

English: (Olof) - “I gave you a chance to live. Now we have to protect ourselves from the masses. We will use the ‘lurkers’ to our advantage.”
Čeština [cs]: (Olof) – „Dal jsem vam sanci prezit. Ted se musime chranit pred ostatnimi. Vyuzijeme cihace ve svuj prospech.“

English: [The ship’s hull grinding against solid rock.]
Čeština [cs]: [Trup lodi drhne o pevnou skalu.]

English: (Captain) - “Get to the lifeboats! Hurry!”
Čeština [cs]: (Kapitan) – „Do zachrannych clunu! Rychle!“

English: (Hanne) - “Olof! You coward!”
Čeština [cs]: (Hanne) – „Olofe! Ty zbabelce!“

English: (Lurker) - *Aggressive snarl.*
Čeština [cs]: (Cihac) – *Agresivni vrceni.*

English: (Captain) - “Watch out!”
Čeština [cs]: (Kapitan) – „Pozor!“

English: [Distorted screams are heard before the tape cuts off.]
Čeština [cs]: [Z pasky se ozyvaji zkreslene vykriky, nez se nahravka prerusi.]

English: Buddy! Yeah, could you be an angel and help me out a bit? I’d owe you big time!
Čeština [cs]: Kamarade! Hele, nemohl bys byt tak hodny a trochu mi pomoct? Budu ti to dluzit!

English: Oh man! I would’ve been a goner without you. Tip for future me: bears are NOT cuddly!
Čeština [cs]: Clovece! Bez tebe bych byl nahrany. Poznamka pro priste: medvedi se NECHTEJI mazlit!

English: Say, you wouldn’t be a rafter, would ya? If ya need some muscle onboard, look no further!
Čeština [cs]: Hele, ty jsi trosecnik, ze jo? Jestli potrebujes na palube trochu svalu, jsem tvuj clovek!

English: Alright, yeah! Leave the heavy lifting to me!
Čeština [cs]: Tak jo! Tezkou praci nech na mne!

English: Ain’t nothing like the fresh breeze. Reminds me of the road trips me and the boys used to go on.
Čeština [cs]: Cerstvy vanek je proste nejlepsi. Pripomina mi vylety autem, na ktere jsem jezdival s kluky.

English: You there. Get me out of this thing.
Čeština [cs]: Ty tam. Dostan me z tohohle.

English: Finally. I thought I’d be stuck here forever.
Čeština [cs]: Konecne. Myslel jsem, ze tu zustanu navzdy.

English: I tried to leave when the first shots were fired. Tangaroa was doomed from the start.
Čeština [cs]: Pokusil jsem se odejit, kdyz padly prvni vystrely. Tangaroa byla odsouzena k zaniku od sameho zacatku.

English: If you get me a ride out of here I can offer you entrepreneurial consulting.
Čeština [cs]: Kdyz mi zajistis odvoz odsud, muzu ti nabidnout podnikatelske poradenstvi.

English: Plus I did some sailing in my youth. Won a few championships. I’ll be useful.
Čeština [cs]: V mladi jsem take trochu plachtil. Vyhral jsem nekolik sampionatu. Budu uzitecny.

Čeština [cs]: Vyborne. Muzes se na me spolehnout.

Čeština [cs]: Ahoj, konecne znama tvar!

Čeština [cs]: Zajima te, jak jsem se sem dostal? Dlouhy pribeh. Opravdu, opravdu dlouhy.

English: Anyway, nice raft. If you need any repairs done, let me know.
Čeština [cs]: Kazdopadne pekny vor. Jestli budes potrebovat neco opravit, dej vedet.

Čeština [cs]: [Nasleduje silny kasel a hluboky nadech.]
